verses.text: Ahabu amaze gupfa, Abanyamowabu baca bagarariza Isirayeli.

Umusi umwe umwami mushasha wa Isirayeli yitwa Ahaziya akoroka aciye mw’idirisha ry’icumba ciwe co hejuru i Samariya, arakomereka cane. Aca atuma intumwa ziwe kumubariza Bayali-Zebubi, ikigirwamana co muri Ekuroni, nimba azokira ico gikomere.

Ariko umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abarira Eliya w’i Tishubi ati: “Haguruka ugende guhura n’intumwa z’umwami w’i Samariya uzibaze uti: ‘Mbega ni kubera yuko muri Isirayeli ata Mana iriho aho muja kubaza Bayali-Zebubi, ikigirwamana c’abo muri Ekuroni?’
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: ‘Aho uryamye ntuzohavyuka, nta nkeka uzopfa.’ ” Nuko Eliya aragenda arabibabwira.
Za ntumwa zisubiye inyuma, umwami arazibaza ati: “Ni kubera iki munyarutse kugaruka?”

Na zo ziramwishura ziti: “Hari umugabo twahuye, atubwira ati: ‘Subira inyuma ku mwami yabarungitse mumubwire muti: Uhoraho avuze ati: Mbega aho muja kubaza Bayali-Zebubi, ikigirwamana c’abo muri Ekuroni, ni kubera yuko ata Mana iri muri Isirayeli? Ati none rero ubwo buriri uryamyeko ntuzobuvako, nta nkeka uzopfa.’ ”
Umwami na we arababaza ati: “Uwo muntu mwahuye akababwira ivyo yari ameze gute?”
Bamwishura bati: “Yari umugabo yambaye umutamana w’ubwoya, akenyeje umukanda w’urusato.” Umwami aca avuga ati: “Uwo ni Eliya w’i Tishubi, nta wundi.”

Aca arungika umukuru w’abasoda mirongo itanu hamwe n’ingabo ziwe kuja gufata Eliya. Basanga yicaye hejuru ku gasozi. Uwo mukuru w’abasoda amubwira ati: “Muntu w’Imana, umwami avuze ngo nuze tumanukane.”

Eliya amwishura ati: “Nimba ndi umuntu w’Imana, umuriro numanuke uvuye mw’ijuru, ubatikize mwese n’abasoda bawe uko ari mirongo itanu!” Ubwo nyene umuriro uca urakoroka uvuye mw’ijuru, utongora uwo mukuru w’abasoda n’abasoda biwe bose.
Umwami arasubira arungika umukuru w’abasoda mirongo itanu hamwe n’izo ngabo ziwe. Uwo mukuru w’abasoda aragenda amubwira ati: “Muntu w’Imana, umwami avuze ngo umanuke vuba!”

Eliya amwishura ati: “Nimba ndi umuntu w’Imana, umuriro numanuke uvuye mw’ijuru, ubatikize mwese n’abasoda bawe uko ari mirongo itanu!” Ubwo nyene umuriro uca urakoroka uvuye mw’ijuru, utongora uwo mukuru w’abasoda n’abasoda biwe bose.

Umwami aca arongera arungika umukuru w’abasoda mirongo itanu agira gatatu hamwe n’izo ngabo ziwe. Uwo mukuru araduga, ashikira Eliya aramupfukamira, amubwira amwinginga ati: “Muntu w’Imana, ndakwinginze ugirire impuhwe amagara yanje n’ay’aba basavyi bawe mirongo itanu.
Raba umuriro umaze gukoroka kabiri kose utongora abakuru b’ingabo hamwe n’ingabo zabo zose. Ndakwinginze ugirire imbabazi ubuzima bwanje.”
Umumarayika w’ Uhoraho abarira Eliya ati: “Manukana na we, kandi ntugire ubwoba.” Eliya aca arahaguruka amanukana na we aho umwami yari ari.

Ashitse aca abwira umwami ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Mbega ni kubera yuko muri Isirayeli ata Mana iriho aho utuma intumwa kubaza Bayali-Zebubi, imana y’abo muri Ekuroni nimba uzokira? Ko wakoze ivyo, ubwo buriri uryamyeko ntuzobuvako, nta nkeka uzopfa.’ ”

Hanyuma Ahaziya arapfa nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryaciye kuri Eliya ryari ryavuze. Kubera ko Ahaziya ata muhungu yari yaravyaye, mwenewabo Yoramu ni we yaciye amusubirira ku ngoma ya Isirayeli, aho hari mu mwaka ugira kabiri Yehoramu mwene Yehoshafati ari ku ngoma i Buyuda.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Ahaziya n’ivyo yakoze vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Igihe Uhoraho yagomba gutwara Eliya mw’ijuru akoresheje agashururu, Eliya yari kumwe na Elisa bari mu rugendo bava i Gilugali.

Eliya abarira Elisa ati: “Wewe sigara ngaha; kuko Uhoraho antumye i Beteli.” Ariko Elisa amubwira ati: “Ndakurahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho no kubaho kwawe, ko ntakuva i ruhande.” Nuko baca baramanukana i Beteli.
Umugwi w’abavugishwa bari i Beteli babarira Elisa bati: “Mbega wamenye ko Uhoraho aza kugutwara shobuja uwu musi?” Elisa arabishura ati: “Egome nabimenye, ariko ntimubivuge!”
Eliya abwira Elisa ati: “Wewe sigara aha, kuko Uhoraho antumye i Yeriko.” Elisa amwishura ati: “Ndakurahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho no kubaho kwawe, ko ntakuva i ruhande.” Nuko bajana i Yeriko.
Umugwi w’abavugishwa baba i Yeriko babwira Elisa bati: “Mbega wamenye ko Uhoraho aza kugutwara Shobuja uwu musi?” Elisa yishura ati: “Egome nabimenye, ariko ntimubivuge!”
Eliya abwira Elisa ati: “Wewe sigara ngaha, kuko Uhoraho antumye kuri Yorodani.” Elisa yishura ati: “Ndakurahiye uguhoraho kw’ Uhoraho no kubaho kwawe, ko ntakuva i ruhande.” Nuko barajana.
Mirongo itanu bo muri wa mugwi w’abavugishwa barabakurikira, bihweza Eliya na Elisa bahagaze kure, babaraba aho bari bahagaze i ruhande y’uruzi Yorodani.

Eliya yambura umutamana wiwe, arawuzingazinga, awukubita amazi y’urwo ruzi. Ubwo nyene ruca rwicamwo kabiri, amazi amwe ahagarara i buryo ayandi i bubamfu, abo bagabo baca bajabuka nk’abagendera kw’isi yumutse.
Bamaze kujabuka, Eliya abarira Elisa ati: “Mbwira ico wipfuza ko ndagukorera imbere y’uko ntandukanywa nawe.” Elisa na we ati: “Mpa incuro zibiri umugabane w’impwemu yawe.”
Eliya amwishura ati: “Unsavye ikintu kigoye, ariko niwabona ingene ntandukanywa nawe, uwo mugabane uraza kuwuronka. Ariko nutambona, nta wo uronka.”
Bakiriko baragenda baganira, haza umukogote w’umuriro ukwegwa n’amafarasi y’umuriro, urabatandukanya, Eliya aduzwa mw’ijuru mu gashururu.
Elisa abonye ivyo, arasemerera ati: “Ewe data we, ewe data we! Wewe wabereye Isirayeli nk’imikogote n’abayigenderako!” Elisa ntiyaba akimubona, aca yitaburirako impuzu ayicamwo kubiri.
Aca atora umutamana wakorotse uva ku bitugu vya Eliya, hanyuma asubira inyuma, ahagarara ku nkengera y’uruzi Yorodani.

Afata wa mutamana wakoroka uva kuri Eliya, awukubita amazi y’urwo ruzi. Abaza ati: “ Uhoraho Mana ya Eliya, uri hehe?” Akubise urwo ruzi ruca rucikamwo kubiri, amazi amwe ahagarara i buryo, ayandi i bubamfu, hanyuma arajabuka.

Maze bamwe bo muri wa mugwi w’abavugishwa b’i Yeriko bariko bararaba ivyariko biraba, baca bavuga bati: “Ya mpwemu ya Eliya isigaye kuri Elisa.” Baca baja kumusanganira, bikubita hasi imbere yiwe baramupfukamira.

Baramubwira bati: “Mugenzi, twebwe abasavyi bawe, turafise abantu mirongo itanu bakomeye twoshobora gutuma. Hamwe uvyemeye boca bagenda kurondera shobuja, kumbure Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho yoba yamusize ku mataba y’imisozi canke mu biyaya.” Elisa abishura ati: “Oya, ntimubatume.”

Ariko babandanya bamwinginga bakobeje, gushika aho vyamugoye ingene abankira. Arateba ababwira ati: “Nimugende.” Haca hagenda abantu mirongo itanu, bamara imisi itatu bamurondera ariko ntibashobora kumutora.
Bagarutse aho Elisa yari ari i Yeriko, arababwira ati: “Sinari nababujije kugenda?”
Umusi umwe, abantu b’i Yeriko babwira Elisa bati: “Databuja, iki gisagara cacu kiri ahantu heza nk’uko nawe uvyibonera, ariko amazi yaco ni mabi, kandi isi yaho na yo ntimera.”
Elisa arababwira ati: “Nimunzanire agakono gashasha, karimwo umunyu.” Nuko barakamuzanira.
Nuko aca aja aho ayo mazi yiburuka ava, atererayo wa munyu, avuga ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Aya mazi ndayavuye. Ntazosubira na rimwe kuzana urupfu, canke ngo atere isi ukutamera.’ ”
Ayo mazi aca aba meza kuva uwo mwanya nk’uko Elisa yabivuze.
Elisa aca ava aho aja i Beteli. Akiri ku nzira agenda, haza abasore bakiri bato bavuye mu gisagara, baramushinyaguriza bamubwira bati: “Va ngaha, busa bw’ubuhanza! Va ngaha busa bw’ubuhanza!”
Aca arahindukira, arabaraba abavuma mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho . Haca haza amadubu abiri y’ingore avuye mw’ishamba, atabagura mirongo ine na babiri muri abo bahungu.
Aca aja ku musozi Karumeli, avaho aja i Samariya.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani Yehoshafati ari umwami w’i Buyuda, ni ho Yehoramu mwene Ahabu yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, amara imyaka cumi n’ibiri ari ku ngoma i Samariya.
Yakoze ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ariko ntiyanganije ububi na se canke nyina. We yarakuyeho inkingi z’amabuye za Bayali se yari yarashinze.
Ariko yagendeye mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakwegeyemwo Abisirayeli. Ntiyigeze ava mu ngeso ziwe.

Kandi umwami Mesha w’i Mowabu yari umworozi w’intama, ku mwaka ku mwaka yategerezwa gushikanira umwami wa Isirayeli imyagazi y’intama ibihumbi ijana, hamwe n’ubwoya bw’impfizi z’intama ibihumbi ijana nyene.
Ariko Ahabu amaze gupfa, umwami wa Mowabu agarariza umwami wa Isirayeli.
Umwami Yehoramu ava i Samariya, aca akoranya abasoda ba Isirayeli bose.

Yongera arungikira ubutumwa Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda ati: “Umwami w’i Mowabu yangararije. Mbega ubona woza kumfasha tugatera Mowabu?” Aramwishura ati: “Nzogufasha, kuko urazi ko turi bamwe, abasoda banje ndabaguhaye, n’amafarasi yanje yose ndayaguhaye.”
Yehoshafati na we aramubaza ati: “Ubona twojana inzira iyihe mu gutera?” Yoramu amwishura ati: “Tuzoca mu bugaragwa bwa Edomu.”

Umwami wa Isirayeli ajana n’umwami w’i Buyuda hamwe n’uwa Edomu, maze bose bafata inzira izunguruka ubugaragwa, bamara imisi indwi bagenda, amazi batekeye arabaherana, babura ayo banywa n’ayo baha ibitungwa biri kumwe na bo.
Umwami wa Isirayeli aravuga ati: “Karabaye! Uhoraho yadukoranije turi abami batatu kugira ngo aturekurire mu maboko y’umwami wa Mowabu!”

Ariko Yehoshafati arabaza ati: “Hano nta muvugishwa w’ Uhoraho n’umwe ahari kugira ngo atubarize Uhoraho ico twokora?” Umwe mu bakuru b’ingabo z’Umwami wa Isirayeli amwishura ati: “Elisa mwene Shafati ari ngaha. Yahora ari umukozi wa Eliya.”
Yehoshafati aravuga ati: “Uwo rero arafise ijambo ry’ Uhoraho .” Nuko umwami wa Isirayeli na Yehoshafati n’umwami wa Edomu baca bamanuka kumurondera.

Elisa aca abaza umwami wa Isirayeli ati: “Mbega twe nawe hari ico duhuriyeko? Genda ubaze ba bavugishwa ba so n’aba nyoko.” Umwami wa Isirayeli aramwishura ati: “Oya, ni kubera ko Uhoraho yadukoranije turi abami batatu, ngo aturekurire mu maboko y’umwami wa Mowabu.”
Elisa aramubwira ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho Mushoboravyose, Imana nkorera, iyo ntasonera Yehoshafati umwami w’i Buyuda, sinari no kwirirwa ndakuraba canke ngo ndanakwiyumvire.
Ariko noneho nimuzanire umuvuzi w’inanga.” Uwo muvuzi w’inanga ariko arayivuza, ububasha bw’ Uhoraho buza kuri Elisa,
aca ababwira ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Iki kiyaya nzocuzuza ibidengeri vy’amazi.
Kuko Uhoraho avuze ati: Nta muyaga muzokwumva kandi nta mvura muzobona, ariko iki kiyaya kizokwuzura amazi, mwebwe ubwanyu, ibitungwa vyanyu vyose, muronke ico munywa.’
Ariko ico ni ikintu gito cane Uhoraho azoba abakoreye, kuko n’Abanyamowabu azobarekurira mu maboko yanyu.
Muzosenyagura impome z’igisagara caho gikuru. Muzotemagura ibiti vyiza vyaho vyose, muzibire n’amariba yabo, indimiro nzizanziza zabo muzozisibanganisha amabuye.”
Bukeye, nko mu gihe co gutanga ibimazi co mu gitondo, amazi yari yamaze gutemba ava muri Edomu, kandi igihugu cose cari cuzuye amazi.
Ico gihe Abanyamowabu bose baramenya ko abo bami baje kubatera, maze abantu bose bari bageze kuja ku rugamba, abakiri bato n’abakuze, barakorana, baja gutegerera ku mbibe.
Bukeye mu gatondo, izuba ryariko rirasira ku mazi, rigatuma asa n’amaraso mu maso y’Abanyamowabu.
Baravuga bati: “Ehe raba ariya maraso! Ba bami bategerezwa kuba bacanyemwo baricana. Yemwe Banyamowabu, haguruka tugende kwegeranya iminyago!”
Ariko bageze ahari ikambi y’Abisirayeli, Abisirayeli baca barahaguruka barabagwanya, Abanyamowabu na bo barahunga. Abisirayeli barabakurikira bagenda barabica ingenda.

Basambura ibisagara vyaho, umuntu wese aterera ibuye mu murima mwiza wose gushika wuzuye amabuye. Basivya amariba yose, batemagura n’igiti ciza cose. Igisagara ca Kiru-Hareseti conyene ni co casigaye gikomeye, ariko na co nyene abasoda bateresha amabuye imigozi baragitera.
Umwami wa Mowabu abonye ko agiye kuneshwa ku rugamba, aca ahitana abasoda amajana indwi bagwanisha inkota ngo arabe uko boca mu ngabo z’umwami wa Edomu, ariko birabananira.
Aca afata umuhungu wiwe yomusubiriye ku ngoma, amutangako ikimazi co guturira, amuherereza ku ruzitiro hejuru. Abisirayeli baca basesemwa n’ico kintu kibi gutyo bavayo basubira mu gihugu cabo.

Umusi umwe, umugore w’umwe mu bavugishwa n’Imana yaje aho Elisa ari, aramutakambira ati: “Umugabo wanje ari we musavyi wawe yarapfuye, kandi urazi ko yari umuntu yubaha Uhoraho . None umuntu dufitiye umwenda aje gutwara abahungu banje ngo abagire abagurano biwe.”
Elisa aramubwira ati: “None nokora iki kugira ngo ndagufashe? Hari ico ufise mu nzu yawe?” Na we amwishura ati: “Jewe umusavyikazi wawe nta co mfise uretse agacupa k’utuvuta twa elayo.”
Elisa amubwira ati: “Genda mu babanyi bawe utire ibivomesho, kandi ntutire bike.
Hanyuma uheze uvyinjirane mu nzu, mwiyugarane n’abahungu bawe. Maze usuke ayo mavuta muri ivyo bivomesho, icuzuye cose mugishire ku ruhande.”
Nuko uwo mugore amusiga aho aragenda, abigira nk’uko yabimubwiye. Abahungu biwe bamuzanira vya bivomesho, na we abisukamwo ya mavuta, kimwekimwe ku kindi.
Vya bivomesho vyose vyuzuye, wa mugore abwira umwe mu bahungu biwe ati: “Nzanira ikindi.” Na we amwishura ati: “Nta na kimwe gisigaye.” Ubwo nyene ya mavuta ntiyasubira kwisuka.
Wa mugore aca aja kubwira wa muntu w’Imana uko vyagenze, na we amubarira ati: “Genda ugurishe ayo mavuta hanyuma wishure umwenda wawe; amahera asigaye azoheza agutunge wewe n’abahungu bawe.”
Umusi umwe Elisa aja gutembera mu gisagara ca Shunemu. Hariho umugore w’umutunzi yabayo, maze atumira Elisa gufungura iwe. Kuva ico gihe, uko Elisa arenganye yama acaho, akamuzimana.
Uwo mugore abarira umugabo wiwe ati: “Sinkekeranya, uwu mugabo yama aca ngaha ni umuntu w’Imana.
Reka tumwubakire icumba hejuru ku nzu, tumushirireyo uburiri, imeza, intebe hamwe n’itara. Niyasubira kugaruka, azoze araronka aho arara.”
Umusi umwe, Elisa asubiye i Shunemu, aduga muri ca cumba co hejuru araruhuka.
Abwira umukozi wiwe Gehazi ati: “Mpamagarira uwo Munyashunemukazi.” Aramuhamagara, na we araza ahagarara imbere ya Elisa.

Elisa abwira Gehazi ati: “Mubwire uti: ‘Watwigoreye cane mu kudukorera ibi vyose. None natwe twogukorera iki? Tuje kukuvugira ku mwami canke ku mukuru w’ingabo?’ ” Ariko uwo mugore amubwira ati: “Jewe nibereyeho neza mu muryango wanje.”
Elisa abaza Gehazi ati: “Ubona twomukorera iki?” Na we ati: “Erega nta gahungu afise, kandi umugabo wiwe arashaje!”
Elisa abwira Gehazi ati: “Subira umumpamagarire.” Wa mugore araza ahagarara mu muryango.

Elisa amubwira ati: “Mu mwaka uza, igihe nicagera nk’aha iki kigeze, uzoba ukikiye umwana w’umuhungu mu maboko yawe.” Ariko uwo mugore amwishura ati: “Oya mugenzi, ntaco ubesha umusavyikazi wawe, kandi uri umuntu w’Imana.”
Ariko uwo mugore aca asama inda, mu mwaka ukurikira, mu gihe nk’ico nyene, avyara umwana w’umuhungu, nk’uko Elisa yari yabimubwiye.
Uwo mwana arakura, maze umusi umwe aja kuraba se mu mirima, aho yari kumwe n’abimbuzi.
Maze abwira se ati: “Ndamenetse umutwe! Ndamenetse umutwe!” Se aca abwira umwe mu bakozi biwe ati: “Muterure umushire nyina.”
Wa mukozi amaze kumutwara kwa nyina, uwo mwana aca yicara ku bibero vyiwe gushika nk’igihe c’isaha zitandatu z’umurango, hanyuma arahwera.
Nyina aca aramudugana amuryamika ku buriri bwa wa muntu w’Imana, aca yugara umuryango arasohoka.
Aca atumako umugabo wiwe ati: “Ndungikira umukozi umwe n’indogoba, kugira ngo nkubitire kuraba wa mukozi w’Imana nca ngaruka.”
Umugabo wiwe aramubaza ati: “Ni kubera iki ugiye kumuraba uwu musi kandi atari ku musi mukuru w’ukwezi canke kw’Isabato?” Umugore na we ati: “Oya nta na kimwe, ni amahoro.”
Aca arategura indogoba, abwira wa mukozi ati: “Hogi tugende twihuta, ntugende bukebuke, kiretse ndakubariye.”
Nuko bafata inzira baragenda, bashikira wa muntu w’Imana ari ku musozi Karumeli. Elisa ababonye bakiri kure, abwira Gehazi ati: “Ehe wa Munyashunemukazi!
Irukanga umutegere, umubaze uti: ‘Muri amahoro mwe n’umugabo wawe n’umwana wawe?’ ” Na we yishura ati: “Turi amahoro.”

Ashikiriye wa muntu w’Imana ku musozi hejuru, yikubita hasi imbere yiwe, amufata ku birenge. Gehazi yegereye ngo amusunure amwigizeyo, Elisa amubwira ati: “Mureke, yuzuye umubabaro mu mutima, kandi Uhoraho yabimpishije, ampisha n’icabitumye.”
Wa mugore abaza Elisa ati: “Mugenzi, mbega ni jewe nari nagusavye umwana? Sinari nakubujije kumpenda?”

Elisa aca abwira Gehazi ati: “Fata umukanda ukenyeze neza umutamana wawe, ufate iyi nkoni yanje hanyuma wiruke. Nihagira abo muhura mu nzira ntimuramukanye, kandi nihagira abakuramutsa ntubasubize. Iyo nkoni uce uyirambika kuri wa mwana.”
Ariko nyina w’uwo mwana abarira Elisa ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho , sindagusiga.” Nuko Elisa ca ajana na we.
Gehazi arirukanga abagenda imbere, arambika ya nkoni kuri wa mwana, ariko umwana ntiyahema canke ngo yikakaze.
Elisa ashitse muri iyo nzu, asanga umuvyimba wa wa mwana uryamye ku buriri bwiwe.
Aca arinjira, ariyugarana, hanyuma asenga Uhoraho .

Aca yurira ku buriri, yubarara kuri wa mwana, umunwa wiwe uja ku munwa w’uwo mwana, amaso yiwe aja ku maso y’uwo mwana, ibiganza vyiwe na vyo bifatana n’ivy’uwo mwana. Akimwubarayeko, umubiri w’umwana utangura gususuruka.
Elisa aca arahaguruka, agendagenda muri ico cumba akanya gatoya, hanyuma asubira ku buriri yongera kumwubararako. Wa mwana aca yasamura incuro indwi, hanyuma aca arakanura.
Elisa aca ahamagara Gehazi, amubwira ati: “Hamagara wa Munyashunemukazi.” Elisa aramuhamagara. Ashitse Elisa amubwira ati: “Akira umwana wawe.”
Arinjira yikubita ku birenge vya Elisa, yubama hasi. Aca atora wa mwana arasohoka.

Igihe kimwe Elisa asubira i Gilugali, kandi ico gihe hari inzara nyinshi. Umusi umwe abiga ibijanye n’ivyo kuvugishwa bari bakoraniye aho Elisa ari, na we abwira umukozi wiwe ati: “Fata inkono nini ushire ku ziko, utekere imboga aba bantu.”

Umwe muri bo aca yirukanga mu gahinga gusoroma imboga, ahasanga umutangatanga awamurako imitangatanga, ayitekera mu mutamana wiwe. Agarutse, ayitemagurira muri ya nkono y’imboga, kuko batari bazi ivyo ari vyo.
Bamaze kwarura izo mboga bagatangura kurya, bakomera induru rimwe bati: “Muntu w’Imana, izi mboga zirimwo ishano.” Ntibashobora kuzirya.
Elisa aca avuga ati: “Nimunzanire agafu.” Aca agasuka muri ya nkono, avuga ati: “Nimuhereze abantu barye.” Nuko basanga nta shano rikiri muri iyo nkono.

Muri ico gihe haza umuntu azananye i Bayali-Shalisha, azaniye uwo muntu w’Imana imikate mirongo ibiri y’ingano zeze ubwa mbere, ayizanye mw’isaho yiwe, amuzanira n’udushishi tw’ingano nshasha. Elisa avuga ati: “Bigaburire abantu babirye.”
Umukozi wiwe amubaza ati: “Nogaburira nte utuntu tungana ukwo abantu ijana?” Ariko Elisa amubwira ati: “Bihereze abandi barye, kuko Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Bararya bongere basigaze.’ ”
Nuko arabibagaburira, bararya mbere haba n’ibisigara, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabivuze.

Hariho umugabo yitwa Namani, yari umukuru ahambaye w’ingabo z’umwami w’i Siriya. Yari afise icubahiro cinshi imbere y’umwami, Uhoraho ni we yacishako intsinzi ya Siriya. Yari umusoda akomeye cane, ariko yari agwaye imibembe.
Abasoda ba Siriya bari barigeze gutera Isirayeli, hanyuma mu bantu bagize inyagano harimwo umukobwa w’Umwisirayelikazi, aca aba incoreke ya muka Namani.
Uwo mukobwa abwira inabuja ati: “Hamwe databuja yoja kuraba umuvugishwa n’Imana aba i Samariya, yomukiza irya mibembe.”
Namani aja kuraba shebuja amubwira ivyo uwo mukobwa w’Umwisirayelikazi yamubwiye.

Umwami w’i Siriya amwishura ati: “Ni vyiza itegure, nanje nzorungikira ikete umwami wa Isirayeli.” Nuko agenda ajanye italanto icumi z’ifeza, shekeli ibihumbi bitandatu z’inzahabu, n’imyambaro cumi y’impuzu.
Ikete yashiriye umwami wa Isirayeli ryarimwo ubu butumwa: “Umusavyi wanje Namani ndamurungikanye iri kete kugira ngo umuvure umukize imibembe.”

Umwami wa Isirayeli akirisoma, aca yitabagurirako impuzu, avuga ati: “Mbega jewe nabaye Imana, ko ari yo ifise ububasha bwo kwica no gukiza abantu? Ni kubera iki amundungikiye ngo ndamuvure imibembe? Aha ntashaka aho ankura gusa kugira ngo asubire kudutera?”

Wa muntu w’Imana Elisa yumvise ko umwami yitaburiyeko impuzu, aca arungika intumwa kumubaza iti: “Ni kubera iki witaburiyeko impuzu? Ndungikira uwo muntu, azomenya ko muri Isirayeli hari umuvugishwa w’ukuri.”
Maze Namani afata ifarasi yiwe n’umukogote wayo aragenda, ahagarara imbere y’umuryango w’inzu ya Elisa.
Elisa aca arungika intumwa, imubwira iti: “Genda woge muri Yorodani incuro indwi, umubiri wawe uraheza usubire uko wahora, ukire imibembe.”

Maze Namani aca arashavura, arivumbura, avuga ati: “Namye niyumvira ko aza gusohoka akaza aho ndi, agahamagara izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe, akazungagiza ikiganza hejuru y’aho ngwaye, hanyuma akankiza imibembe.
Mbega inzuzi Abana na Farupara z’i Damasiko, si zo nziza kuruta inzuzi zose zo muri Isirayeli? Sinari kuja kuzogamwo ngakira?” Namani aca asubira inyuma ashavuye cane.

Abagendanyi biwe baramukurikira, bamubwira bati: “Databuja, iyo uwo muvugishwa akubwira gukora ibikomeye kurusha ivyo ntiwari kubikora? None akubwiye ati: ‘Genda woge urakira,’ ntakubwiye ivyoroshe cane?”
Nuko aramanuka, yibira muri Yorodani incuro indwi, nk’uko wa muntu w’Imana yari yamubwiye, umubiri wiwe uca usubira kuba muzima, umera nk’uw’umwana mutoya.

Namani n’abari bamuherekeje baca basubira kwa wa muntu w’Imana. Ahagarara imbere yiwe aramubwira ati: “Noneho menye neza ko mw’isi yose ata yindi Mana ibaho atari muri Isirayeli. None rero ndakwinginze wakire ishikanwa ry’umusavyi wawe.”
Wa muvugishwa aramubwira ati: “Ndakurahiye Uhoraho , Imana nkorera, ko ntashobora kwakira ikintu na kimwe.” Namani agerageza kumwinginga ngo abimwakirire, ariko aranka.

Namani amubwira ati: “Ko unyankiye, reka mpfume ntwara ivu rya hano ryotwarwa n’indogoba zibiri, kuko jewe umusavyi wawe ntazosubira gushikanira ikimazi gituriwe canke ngo nshikanire ishikanwa iyindi mana atari Uhoraho .
Ariko Uhoraho ambabarire kuri iki kimwe. Databuja niyinjira mu ngoro y’ikigirwamana Rimoni kucunamira, hanyuma akishimikiza ukuboko kwanje, Uhoraho azombabarire ninunama.”
Elisa amubwira ati: “Niwigire amahoro.”

Namani amaze kugenda urugendo rutari ruto, Gehazi umukozi wa Elisa umuntu w’Imana yibwira ati: “Databuja yorohereje cane uwu Musiriya, ntiyari akwiye kwanka kwakira ivyo yamuzaniye. Ndarahiye Uhoraho , singenda ntamukurikiye ngo ngire ico ndamukuyeko.”
Nuko Gehazi aca yoma inyuma Namani. Namani abonye ko ariko araza amukurikira, aca yururuka umukogote, aja guhura na we, aramubaza ati: “Ni amahoro?”

Gehazi aramwishura ati: “Ni amahoro. Databuja antumye kukubwira ko hari babiri bo mu biga ibijanye no kuvugishwa bavuye mu mitumba yo mu ntara ya Efurayimu bamugendeye. None ngo bahe italanto imwe y’ifeza n’imyambaro ibiri y’impuzu.”

Namani amubwira amwinginga ati: “Ahubwo nutware italanto zibiri.” Aca afata italanto zibiri azihambirira hamwe azishira mu mufuko, amuhana n’imyambaro ibiri y’impuzu, aca abiha abakozi biwe babiri ngo babitware bitangire imbere Gehazi.
Bageze ku mpinga y’umusozi, Gehazi aca asaba ba bakozi za ngabire bari bazanye azinyegeza i muhira iwe, aca arabarungika basubira inyuma.
Asubiye kwa shebuja, aramubaza ati: “Uvuye he ga Gehazi?” Gehazi yishura ati: “Umusavyi wawe nta na hamwe yari yaroye.”

Ariko Elisa aramubaza ati: “Mbe ntuzi ko impwemu yanje yari harya igihe Namani yururuka umukogote wiwe aza guhura nawe? Mbega iki ni igihe co kwakira amahera, impuzu, imirima y’imyelayo n’iy’imizabibu, ibitungwa, n’abagurano?
Ko wakoze ivyo, imibembe ya Namani izokwomako wewe n’uruvyaro rwawe ibihe vyose.” Ako kanya nyene Gehazi aca ava imbere ya Elisa ajejeta imibembe, yera derere.
Umusi umwe, umugwi w’abavugishwa baja kuraba Elisa bamubwira bati: “Ehe raba aha hantu twama dukoranira na wewe ni hato cane ntitukihakwirwa.
Reka tumanuke kuri Yorodani, umwe wese azane igiti, maze twiyubakire inzu yo gukoraniramwo.” Elisa ababwira ati: “Egome, nimugende.”
Umwe muri bo aramubaza ati: “None wewe ntujana n’abasavyi bawe?” Elisa ati: “Egome, turajana.”
Nuko bamanuka kuri Yorodani, batangura kurondera ibiti vyo kwubaka.
Umwe muri bo ariko araca igiti, ishoka yiwe iraroka igwa mu mazi. Aca arasemerera ati: “Ndagowe mugenzi! Iyo shoka yari iyo natiye!”
Wa muntu w’Imana aramubaza ati: “Yakorokeye he?” Ahamweretse, Elisa aca aca agashami k’igiti agaterera aho yakorokeye, ya shoka ica irareremba ku mazi.
Aramubwira ati: “Yitore.” Wa muntu aca atuma ukuboko arayitora.
Igihe umwami w’i Siriya yariko aragwana na Isirayeli, yahora abwira abasoda biwe ati: “Nzoshira amakambi y’abasoda aha n’aha.”
Maze uwo muntu w’Imana Elisa, agaca arungika intumwa ku mwami wa Isirayeli ati: “Uze wirinde ntuce mu kibanza iki n’iki, kuko abasoda b’umwami w’i Siriya ari ho bateguye gushinga ikambi yabo.”
Umwami wa Isirayeli na we agaca atohoza ivy’aho hantu uwo muntu w’Imana yavuze. Biba kenshi Elisa na we akama aburira umwami wa Isirayeli, kugira ngo yame agavye.
Ivyo bitera umwami w’i Siriya kuraka. Atumako abakuru mu ngabo ziwe zose ababaza ati: “Ni nde muri mwebwe amena amabanga? Ni nde abwira integuro zacu umwami wa Isirayeli?”
Umwe muri abo bakuru amwishura ati: “Nta n’umwe muri twebwe mwami nyeningoma, ariko Elisa umuvugishwa wo muri Isirayeli, ni we abwira umwami wa Isirayeli n’ijambo uvugiye ku buriri uryamako.”
Uwo mwami na we aca ababwira ati: “Genda mubaririkize aho ari kugira ndungike abasoda kumufata.” Maze baragaruka bamubwira bati: “Ari i Dotani.”
Aca arungikayo imikogote n’amafarasi hamwe n’abasoda benshi, bagenda mw’ijoro, bakikuza igisagara.
Umukozi wa Elisa avyutse kare mu gatondo, arasohoka, abona abasoda benshi n’amafarasi n’imikogote, bakikuje igisagara. Wa mukozi arasemerera ati: “Karabaye databuja! Mbega tubigenza gute?”
Wa muvugishwa amubwira ati: “Ntugire ubwoba. Abari kumwe natwe basumba abari kumwe na bo.”

Elisa aca asenga avuga ati: “ Uhoraho we, ugurura amaso yiwe kugira ngo abone.” Maze Uhoraho yugurura amaso y’uwo mukozi, yunamuye amaso abona imitumba yuzuye amafarasi n’imikogote y’umuriro bikikuje Elisa.
Abo bansi bakimanuka baza aho Elisa yari ari, aca arasenga avuga ati: “ Uhoraho we, suka uruhumyi kuri abo bantu.” Nuko Uhoraho abasukako uruhumyi nk’uko Elisa abisavye.
Elisa aca ababwira ati: “Mwafashe inzira itari yo, kandi n’igisagara bababwiye si iki. Nimunkurikire ndabatware ku wo murondera.” Nuko aca abatwara i Samariya.
Bamaze kwinjira mu gisagara, Elisa asenga avuga ati: “ Uhoraho we, ugurura amaso y’aba basoda kugira ngo babone.” Uhoraho abugurura amaso barabona, basanga bashitse hagati mu gisagara i Samariya.
Umwami wa Isirayeli ababonye, abaza Elisa ati: “Data, ndabice? Uranyemereye ndabice?”
Aramwishura ati: “Ntubice. Wokwicisha inkota canke umuheto abantu wafatishije amaboko? Ahubwo bahe ivyokurya ubahe n’amazi, barye hanyuma basubire kwa shebuja.”
Nuko abategurira amazimano akomeye, bahejeje kurya no kunywa aca arabarungika basubira kwa shebuja. Kuva ico gihe, imigwi y’abasuma bo muri Siriya ntiyabaye igisubira kwinjira mu gihugu ca Isirayeli.
Haheze igihe, Beni-Hadadi umwami w’i Siriya akoranya ingabo ziwe zose, baja kwugariza Samariya.

Hatera inzara ikomeye mu gisagara, imara igihe kirekire gushika aho umutwe w’indogoba wagurwa shekeli mirongo umunani z’ifeza, n’ica kane n’ingero kabu y’amase y’inuma na yo kikagurwa shekeli zitanu z’ifeza.
Umusi umwe umwami wa Isirayeli yariko aragendagenda ku ruzitiro, yumva umugore asemerera avuga ati: “Ntabara se mwami nyeningoma!”
Umwami amwishura ati: “Nimba Uhoraho atagutabaye, jewe nokura he ico kugufashisha? Nta kintu na kimwe gisigaye. Ku mbuga yo gukubitirako ingano canke mu bwato bwo kuganiramwo umuvinyu.”
Ariko arongera amubaza ati: “Ufise ingorane nki?” Na we amwishura ati: “Uyu mugore yambwiye ati: ‘Zana umuhungu wawe tumurye uwu musi, ejo na ho tuzorya uwanje.’
Nuko uwiwanje turamuteka turamurya. Bukeye ndamubwira nti: ‘Zana umuhungu wawe na we tumurye.’ Ariko aca aramunyegeza.”
Umwami yumvise amajambo y’uwo mugore, yitaburirako impuzu. Uko yagendagenda ku ruzitiro, abanyagisagara bose bamurabira hasi, bamubona yambaye igunira ryonyene.
Aravuga ati: “Imana ibimpanire, kandi bihambaye, uwu musi umutwe wa Elisa mwene Shafati niwarara ugifatanye n’ibitugu vyiwe.”

Elisa yari yicaye i muhira iwe, ari kumwe n’abatware. Umwami aca arungika intumwa imbere yiwe, ariko bataranashika, Elisa abarira ba batware ati: “Murabona ingene uwu mwicanyi arungitse umuntu kunca umutwe! Niyashika muce mwugara umuryango, mumwugaranire hanze. Ibirenge vya shebuja ntimuvyumva inyuma yiwe?”
Akiriko arababwira ivyo, ya ntumwa iba irabashikiriye. Umwami aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho ni we aduteye aya magorwa yose. None noba nkimwitezeko iki?”

headings.text: Elisa ahuma amaso abasoda baje kumutera
Ikigoyi gitera i Samariya kubera kwugarizwa

verses.text: Elisa aca avuga ati: “Nimwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho . Uhoraho avuze ati: ‘Ejo nk’aya mango, kw’irembo ry’i Samariya, ingero seya imwe y’ifu inoze neza izogurwa shekeli imwe n’ingero seya zibiri za sayiri zizogurwa shekeli imwe.’ ”
Umukuru w’ingabo umwami yagenda yishimikije yishura uwo muntu w’Imana ati: “Naho Uhoraho yokwugurura ingomero zo mw’ijuru, ivyo ntivyoshoboka.” Elisa aca amubwira ati: “Uzobibona ariko ntuzobiryako!”
Kw’irembo ry’igisagara hariho abantu bane babaho bagwaye imibembe. Barabazanya bati: “Mbega ni kubera iki tuguma twicaye ngaha gushika aho twicwa n’inzara?

Nitwaja mu gisagara, hariyo inzara, izotwicirayo. Kandi nitwaguma ngaha, na ho nyene izotwica. Ehe rero nimuze tuje hariya kw’ikambi y’Abasiriya, twishikane. Nibatugirira imbabazi tuzobaho. Nayo nibatwica, n’ubu turapfuye.”
Uwo mugoroba nyene bafata inzira baja kw’ikambi y’Abasiriya, basanga nta muntu n’umwe ahari.

Imana yari yatumye Abasiriya bumva urwamo rw’imikogote n’amafarasi hamwe n’abasoda benshi cane, bituma babwirana bati: “Erega noneho umwami wa Isirayeli yakoranije umwami w’Abaheti n’uwa Egiputa baza kudutera!”
Maze uwo mugoroba nyene bakura hasi barahunga, bata amahema yabo n’amafarasi n’indogoba zabo. Basiga ibintu vyabo vyose uko vyari biri, banyaga amagara.

Ba bantu bagwaye imibembe bashitse aho ayo mahema yabo atangurira, binjira mw’ihema rimwe. Bararya, baranywa, bongera batora inzahabu, ifeza n’impuzu, baja kubinyegeza. Baragaruka binjira mu rindi hema, batorayo ibindi, na vyo nyene baja kubinyegeza.

Hanyuma barabwirana bati: “Ariko ivyo turiko turakora si vyiza. Uwu ni umusi w’inkuru nziza, none turiko turawigungana. Nitwarindira bugaca, igihano kizotugwako. Reka tugende ubu nyene kubivuga i bwami.”

Nuko baragenda bahamagara abarinzi b’irembo ry’igisagara, bababwira bati: “Twinjiye mw’ikambi y’Abasiriya, nta muntu n’umwe twasanzeyo, nta n’agakacira, atari indogoba n’amafarasi biziritse, amahema na yo bayataye uko yakabaye.”
Ba barinzi b’irembo ry’igisagara baca barasemerera bavuga iyo nkuru nziza, maze na yo ishikira abo ku kirimba c’umwami.

Umwami aca arahaguruka iryo joro nyene, abarira abatware biwe ati: “Reka ndababwire ico Abasiriya bagomba kudukorera. Barazi ko inzara itwishe, none bavuye mw’ikambi baja kwinyegeza mu gahinga, biteze ko tuva mu gisagara kugira ngo bace badufata hamwe n’igisagara.”

Umwe mu bakuru b’ingabo avuga ati: “Reka turungike abantu bafata amafarasi atanu asigaye mu gisagara baje kuraba ivyo bintu. Nihagira ico baba, ni co kimwe n’aho boguma ngaha bagapfana n’Abisirayeli bose.”
Nuko baca bafata imikogote ibiri n’indogoba zayo, umwami arabarungika ngo bakurikire abasoda b’Abasiriya. Abwira abagendera kuri ayo mafarasi ati: “Genda murabe ivyabaye.”
Nuko barabakurikirana gushika kuri Yorodani, basanga ibarabara ryuzuyemwo impuzu n’ibindi bikoresho Abasiriya bagiye barata mu nzira bahunga. Za ntumwa ziragaruka zibibwira umwami.

Maze abantu barasohoka, baja gusahura ivyo muri ya kambi y’Abasiriya. Ni ho ingero seya y’ifu inoze neza yagurwa shekeli imwe, n’ingero seya zibiri za sayiri zigurwa shekeli imwe, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabivuze.

Wa mukuru mu ngabo umwami yagenda yishimikije ashingwa igikorwa co gucungera uruja n’uruza kw’irembo, ariko aratemba kubera umusunikano w’abantu, na bo baramuhonyanga gushika apfuye, nk’uko wa muntu w’Imana yari yabivuze igihe umwami yari aje i muhira iwe.

Vyagenze nk’uko uwo muntu w’Imana yari yabibwiye umwami ati: “Ejo nk’aya mango, kw’irembo ry’i Samariya, ingero seya imwe y’ifu inoze neza izogurwa shekeli imwe n’ingero seya zibiri za sayiri zizogurwa shekeli imwe.”

Iyo ntwazangabo yari yabwiye uwo muntu w’Imana iti: “Naho Uhoraho yokwugurura ingomero zo mw’ijuru, ivyo ntivyoshoboka.” Uwo muntu w’Imana arababwira ati: “Uzobirabisha amaso yawe, ariko ntuzobiryako.”
Kandi vyagenze uko nyene, kuko abantu bamuhonyangiye kw’irembo ry’igisagara aca arapfa.

Elisa yari yarabwiye wa mugore w’i Shunemu, nyina wa wa mwana yasubiza ubuzima, ati: “Raba iyo uja n’umuryango wawe muve ngaha mumareyo igihe, kuko Uhoraho agira ateze inzara izomara imyaka indwi muri Isirayeli.”
Uwo mugore aca abikora nk’uko uwo muntu w’Imana yari yabimubwiye. Ahitana umuryango wiwe aja kuba mu guhugu c’Abafilisitiya, amarayo imyaka indwi.
Iyo myaka indwi iheze, aragaruka ava mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya, aja gusaba umwami inzu n’itongo.
Ashitse asanga umwami ariko aganira na Gehazi amubaza ati: “Mbwira ibintu bihambaye vyose Elisa yakoze.”

Gehazi akiriko arabwira umwami ingene Elisa yasengeye umwana yapfuye akongera akaba muzima, uwo mugore nyina w’uwo mwana arashika, asaba umwami inzu hamwe n’itongo. Gehazi aca avuga ati: “Mwami wanje, uwo ni wa mugore nakubwira Elisa yasubiriza umwana ubuzima kandi na nya mwana ni uwu.”

Umwami aca amubaza ingene vyagenze na we arabimwiganira. Umwami aca ategeka umutware kumukurikiranira ibintu vyiwe no kubimusubiza, harimwo n’igiciro c’ivyo bimbuye vyose muri iryo tongo igihe atari ho ari.
Umusi umwe, Elisa aja i Damasiko, kandi ico gihe Beni-Hadadi, umwami w’i Siriya, yari agwaye. Haza umuntu amubwira ati: “Wa muntu w’Imana yashitse ino.”
Umwami avyumvise, abarira Hazayeli ati: “Tora amashikanwa uje kumusanganira, umubwire ambarize Uhoraho ko nzokira iyi ngwara.”

Hazayeli aja gusanganira Elisa atwaye amashikanwa agizwe n’ibintu vy’agaciro vy’i Damasiko, vyikorewe n’ingamiya mirongo ine. Aragenda ahagarara imbere yiwe amubwira ati: “Umusavyi wawe Beni-Hadadi, umwami w’i Siriya, andungitse kukubaza ko azokira ingwara agwaye.”
Elisa amwishura ati: “Genda umubwire uti: ‘Uzokira.’ Ariko Uhoraho yampishuriye ko azopfa.”
Aca ahagarara imbere ya Hazayeli amuraba mu maso gushika aho yumva isoni. Uwo muntu w’Imana aca atangura kurira.

Hazayeli aramubaza ati: “Mbega nyakwubahwa ni iki gitumye urira?” Na we amwishura ati: “Ni kubera nzi ivyago uzoteza Abisirayeli. Uzoturira ibisagara vyabo bizitiye, umarishe inkota imikangara yabo, ufyonyagure inzoya zabo, ufomoze n’inda abagore babo bibungenze.”
Hazayeli aramubaza ati: “Mbega umusavyi wawe nkanje ata co amaze, nokora ibintu bihambaye gutyo nte?” Elisa amwishura ati: “ Uhoraho yanyeretse ko uzoba umwami w’i Siriya.”
Hazayeli aca asiga Elisa aho, asubira kwa shebuja. Beni-Hadadi amubajije ati: “Elisa yakubwiye ngw’iki?” Na we amwishura ati: “Yambwiye ko ata nkeka, uzokira.”
Ariko bukeye, Hazayeli afata uburengeti abuzinga incuro nyinshi, abwinika mu mazi, hanyuma abutsindagira mu maso h’umwami gushika acikanye. Hazayeli aca aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira gatanu Yoramu mwene Ahabu ari umwami wa Isirayeli, ni ho Yehoramu mwene Yehoshafati umwami w’Abayuda, na we yaba umwami w’i Buyuda.
Ico gihe yari afise imyaka mirongo itatu n’ibiri, amara imyaka umunani aganza ari i Yerusalemu.
Agendera mu ngeso z’abami b’Abisirayeli, nk’uko ab’inzu ya Ahabu bakora, kuko yarongoye umukobwa wa Ahabu. Akora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho .
Ariko kubera isezerano Uhoraho yari yaragiraniye na Dawidi umusavyi wiwe, Uhoraho ntiyashaka guherengeteza Ubuyuda. Yari yarasezeranye kugumizaho itara ryiwe n’uruvyaro rwiwe ibihe vyose.
Mu gihe Yehoramu yari ku ngoma, Abanyedomu bagarariza Abayuda biyimikira umwami wabo.

Maze Yoramu aca aja gutera i Zayiri ajanye n’imikogote yiwe yose. Abanyedomu baramukikuza, ariko mw’ijoro aravyuka arasohoka, yicira inzira muri bo aragenda, ingabo ziwe na zo zirahunga zisubira i muhira.
Kuva ico gihe Abanyedomu baca barikukira, bikura ku Buyuda gushika n’ubu. N’igisagara c’i Libuna na co nyene gica kiragarariza.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yoramu hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyanditse mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami b’i Buyuda.
Hanyuma Yoramu ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Ahaziya amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri Yoramu mwene Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli ari ku ngoma, Ahaziya mwene Yehoramu umwami w’i Buyuda ni ho yima nk’umwami.
Ahaziya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza umwaka umwe ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Ataliya umwuzukuru wa Omuri umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Agendera mu ngeso z’ab’inzu ya Ahabu, akora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , kuko yari afitaniye ubucuti n’umuryango wa Ahabu.
Ahaziya ajana na Yoramu mwene Ahabu kugwanya Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya i Ramoti Gileyadi, maze Abasiriya bakomeretsa Yoramu.

Nuko umwami Yoramu aca asubira i Yezireyeli kugira ngo akirireyo ibikomere Abasiriya bamukomerekereje i Ramoti igihe yariko aragwana na Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya. Maze Ahaziya mwene Yehoramu umwami w’i Buyuda aramanuka aja i Yezireyeli gusuhuza Yoramu mwene Ahabu kuko yari yarakomeretse.
Umusi umwe, Elisa ahamagara umwe mu bigishwa b’abavugishwa, amubarira ati: “Itegure utware aka gacupa k’amavuta ya Elayo i Ramoti Gileyadi.
Niwashikayo urondere Yehu mwene Yehoshafati, umwuzukuru wa Nimushi. Uce umukura mu mugwi wa bagenziwe, umwihereranye mu cumba c’imbere mu nzu.

Uce ufata aka gacupa, umusukeko aya mavuta ya elayo ku mutwe, umubwire uti: ‘ Uhoraho avuze ati: Ndagutoranije ngo ube Umwami wa Isirayeli.’ Maze uheze uce wugurura umuryango wiruke, ukize amagara yawe!”
Maze uwo musore w’umuvugishwa aja i Ramoti Gileyadi.
Ashitseyo, yegera aho abakuru b’ingabo bari, avuga ati: “Nyakwubahwa, ndafise ico ndakubwira!” Yehu aramubaza ati: “Ukeneye nde muri twebwe?” Na we amwishura ati: “Wewe nyene, nyakwubahwa!”

Nuko Yehu arahaguruka yinjira mu nzu. Wa muvugishwa amusuka amavuta ku mutwe, avuga ati: “ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ati: ‘Ndakurobanuje amavuta kugira ngo ube umwami w’ubwoko bw’ Uhoraho , ari bwo Isirayeli.
Uzotikize umuryango wa shobuja Ahabu, kugira ngo mpore amaraso y’abasavyi banje b’abavugishwa n’ay’abandi basavyi b’ Uhoraho bose yasheshwe na Yezebeli.
Abo mu nzu ya Ahabu bose nzobatikiza. Icitwa umugabo cose muri Isirayeli, yaba umugurano canke uwidegemvya.
Umuryango wa Ahabu nzowugira nk’uwa Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, co kimwe n’umuryango wa Bayasha mwene Ahiya.
Nayo Yezebeli nta n’uwuzomuhamba, kuko imbwa zizomurira aho azogwa i Yezireyeli.’ ” Wa muvugishwa aca yugurura umuryango ariruka.
Yehu asohotse agasubira muri bagenziwe, baramubaza bati: “Ni amahoro? Urya musazi yakuronderera iki?” Yehu arabishura ati: “Ntimuzi, bene barya ivyo bakunda kudebagura?”
Na bo bamubwira bati: “Reka kutubesha, tubwire ivyo akubwiye.” Maze abishura ati: “Ambariye ati: ‘Ndagusize amavuta ngo ndagutoranye ube umwami wa Isirayeli.’ ”
Ubwo nyene baca bakura imitamana yabo barayimusasira aho yari ahagaze ku ngazi z’amabuye, bavuza inzamba, basemerera bati: “Umwami Yehu naganze!”
Nuko Yehu mwene Yehoshafati akaba n’umwuzukuru wa Nimushi, ategura umugambi wo kwica Yoramu. Imbere y’aho, Yoramu yari amaze imisi ku rugamba i Ramoti Gileyadi agwanya Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya.

Ariko yari yagarutse i Yezireyeli kwivuza ibikomere yakomerekejwe n’Abasiriya igihe yari ku rugamba. Yehu abwira abo bari kumwe ati: “Nimba mugomba ko mba umwami wanyu, nimucungere kino gisagara kugira ngo ntihagire n’umwe asohoka ngo aje kuvuga inkuru y’ivyabaye i Yezireyeli.”
Maze aca yurira umukogote wiwe, aja i Yezireyeli, kuko Yoramu ari yo yari aruhukiye kandi na Ahaziya umwami w’i Buyuda na we yari yamanutseyo kumusuhuza.

Umuraririzi yari ku munara w’i Yezireyeli abonye Yehu n’abasoda biwe begereje, arasemerera ahamagara Yoramu, amubwira ati: “Ndabona abasoda baje hano.” Yoramu amubwira ati: “Rungika umusoda umwe afate ifarasi, agende abategere, ababaze ati: ‘Mugenzwa n’amahoro?’ ”

Wa musoda agendera kw’ifarasi ahura na Yehu aramubaza ati: “Umwami antumye kubabaza ko mugenzwa n’amahoro.” Yehu amwishura ati: “Ivyo vy’amahoro wewe ubishakako iki? Herera inyuma yanje, nta kindi.” Wa muraririzi abwira umwami ati: “Umuntu twatumye yabashikiriye ariko ntiyagarutse.”

Yoramu atuma uwugira kabiri agendera kw’ifarasi. Na we abashikiriye ababwira ati: “Umwami antumye kubabaza ko mugenzwa n’amahoro.” Yehu amwishura ati: “Ivyo vy’amahoro wewe ubishakako iki? Herera inyuma yanje, nta kindi.”
Wa muraririzi aravuga ati: “Yabashikiriye, ariko na we nyene ntiyagarutse. Mbona umuntu ategerezwa kuba ari Yehu mwuzukuru wa Nimushi, ni we atwara ifarasi nk’umusazi.”

Yoramu aca avuga ati: “Nimuntegurire umukogote ningoga.” Bamaze kuwutegura, Yoramu umwami wa Isirayeli na Ahaziya umwami w’i Buyuda baca baragenda, umwe wese mu mukogote wiwe, baja gutegera Yehu. Bahurira mw’itongo ryahora ari irya Naboti w’i Yezireyeli.
Yoramu ashikiriye Yehu, aramubaza ati: “Ugenzwa n’amahoro?” Yehu aramwishura ati: “Nogenzwa n’amahoro gute kandi ugusenga ibigirwamana n’ubupfumu vya nyoko Yezebeli vyuzuye muri twebwe?”
Yoramu aca arahindukira ngo ahunge, agenda arasemerera ati: “Ahaziya we, ukampinduka!”
Yehu aca afata umuheto wiwe arasa Yoramu mu mugongo, umwampi umutobekeranya mu mutima, aca agwa mu mukogote aracikana.

Yehu aca abarira Bidikari uwatwara umukogote wiwe ati: “Mutore uje kumuterera mu murima wahoze ari uwa Naboti w’i Yezireyeli. Uribuka ko twe nawe twari mu mukogote umwe inyuma ya se wiwe Ahabu igihe Uhoraho yavuga ivyiwe

ati: ‘Ndarahiye icese ko nzohorera amaraso ya Naboti n’ay’abahungu biwe, ni ko jewe Uhoraho mvuze, kandi ko muri iri tongo nyene ari ho nzobahorera, ni ko jewe Uhoraho mvuze.’ None rero mutware umuterere muri iryo tongo nk’uko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryavuze.”

Ahaziya umwami w’i Buyuda abonye ibibaye, aca afata ibarabara rija i Beti-Hagani, arahunga. Yehu aramukurikira avuga ati: “Murase na we nyene!” Bamukomerekereza mu mukogote wiwe hafi ya Ibileyamu ariko araduga i Guri, ariko arabasiga aja i Megido, agwayo.
Abasavyi biwe baca bamushira mu mukogote bamutwara i Yerusalemu, bamuhamba hamwe na ba sekuruza, mu Gisagara ca Dawidi.
Ahaziya yari yabaye umwami w’i Buyuda mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri Yoramu mwene Ahabu ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli.
Hanyuma Yehu aja i Yezireyeli. Yezebeli avyumvise, yisiga agahama ku maso, arisokoza umushatsi, aca yicara araba mw’idirisha.
Abonye Yehu yinjiye mw’irembo aramubaza ati: “Uzanywe n’iki ga wa mwicanyi we? Umeze nka Zimuri yishe shebuja!”
Yehu yunamurira amaso kuri rya dirisha, avuga ati: “Ni nde ari ku ruhande rwanje? Ni nde?” Inkone zibiri canke zitatu zimurunguruka ziri mw’idirisha.
Yehu azibarira ati: “Mukororere hasi!” Na zo zica zimukororera hasi, arasaba, amaraso yiwe atarukira ku mpome, Yehu na we amuhonyangisha ifarasi.
Yehu yinjira mu nzu, ararya, aranywa. Aca avuga ati: “Nihagire uwufata uwo mugore w’ikivume amuhambe, kuko yari umukobwa w’umwami.”
Ariko basohotse ngo baje kumuhamba, basanga hasigaye agahanga hamwe n’amaguru n’amaboko.

Baca basubira inyuma babibwira Yehu, na we avuga ati: “Iri ni ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rishitse, iryavuzwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Eliya w’i Tishubi, aho yavuga ati: ‘Mw’itongo ry’i Yezireyeli ni ho imbwa zizorira umuvyimba wa Yezebeli.
Umuvyimba wa Yezebeli uzosanzara nk’umwavu mw’itongo ry’i Yezireyeli, kugira ngo ntihazogire n’uwoshobora kuvuga ati: Uwu ni Yezebeli.’ ”
Ahabu yari afise abahungu mirongo indwi baba i Samariya. Maze Yehu yandika amakete ayarungika i Samariya ku bakuru b’igisagara, ku batware no ku bacungera abana ba Ahabu. Yanditse avuga ati:
“Abahungu b’umwami bari kumwe namwe, kandi mufise imikogote, amafarasi igisagara kizitiye, hamwe n’ibigwanisho. None rero nimwabona iri kete,
muce mutoranya mu bahungu ba Ahabu uwubereye kuba umwami wanyu, muheze mwitegurire kugwanira umuryango wa Ahabu.”
Ariko baterwa n’ubwoba, bavuga bati: “Nimba abami babiri batashoboye kugwanya uwu Yehu, twebwe twoshobora kumugwanya dute?”

Nuko uwujejwe ikirimba ari kumwe n’umukuru w’igisagara hamwe n’abatware n’abacungera abana ba Ahabu barungikira ubutumwa Yehu bavuga bati: “Turi abasavyi bawe, tuzokora ivyo uzotubwira vyose, nta mwami twimika, nukore ivyo ubona bibereye vyose.”

Yehu aca abarungikira amakete ubwa kabiri avuga ati: “Nimba muri ku ruhande rwanje mukiyemeza kunyubaha, Nimuce imitwe abahungu ba shobuja, muzoyinsanze i Yezireyeli ejo nk’aya mango.” Ico gihe abo bana b’umwami uko bari mirongo indwi bari kumwe n’abatware b’igisagara babaha indero y’i bwami.
Ayo makete abashikiriye, baca bafata ba bana b’umwami babaca imitwe bose uko ari mirongo indwi. Bashira imitwe yabo mu biseke, bayirungikira Yehu i Yezireyeli.
Intumwa iragenda ibarira Yehu iti: “Bazanye imitwe ya ba bana b’umwami.” Yehu na we aca ategeka ati: “Nimuyirunde mu bwinjiriro bw’igisagara, muyigumizeho gushika ejo mu gitondo.”
Bukeye mu gatondo Yehu arasohoka, ahagarara imbere y’ikoraniro avuga ati: “Mwebwe nta caha mufise. Ni jewe nateguye kwica databuja Yoramu nongera ndabishitsa. Ariko aba bobo bishwe na nde?
Nimumenye ko ata jambo Uhoraho yavuze ku muryango wa Ahabu ritazoshika. Uhoraho ashikije ivyo yavuze aciye ku musavyi wiwe Eliya.”
Hanyuma Yehu yica abo mu muryango wa Ahabu bose bari basigaye i Yezireyeli, hamwe n’abatware biwe bari bahambaye, abagenzi biwe n’abaherezi biwe, ntiyasigaza n’umwe.
Yehu aca arahaguruka aja i Samariya. Akiri mu nzira, ageze i Beti-Ekedi h’Abungere,
ahura na bamwe bo mu ncuti za Ahaziya umwami w’i Buyuda, arababaza ati: “Muri ba nde?” Na bo bamwishura bati: “Turi incuti za Ahaziya, tugiye kuramutsa abahungu b’umwami Ahaziya hamwe n’umugabekazi.”
Yehu aca atanga itegeko ati: “Bafatishe amaboko!” Baca barabafata babicira i ruhande y’iriba ry’i Beti-Ekedi. Abishwe bari abagabo mirongo ine na babiri. Ntiyasigaje n’uwo kuvuga inkuru.

Avuye aho aca ahura na Yehonadabu mwene Rekabu, yari aje kumutegera. Yehu aramuramutsa, amubaza ati: “Mbega uranyoboka nk’uko nanje ndakuyoboka?” Yehonadabu yishura ati: “Ego cane.” Yehu amubwira ati: “Niwaba unyoboka, mpa ukuboko kwawe.” Yehonadabu amuha ukuboko, na we amwuriza mu mukogote wiwe.
Yehu amubwira ati: “Ingo tujane, wirabire ishaka mfitiye Uhoraho .” Nuko bajana muri uwo mukogote.
Yehu ashitse i Samariya, yica abari basigaye mu muryango wa Ahabu bose, arabatikiza nk’uko ijambo Uhoraho yabwiye Eliya ryabivuze.
Yehu akoranya abantu bose ababwira ati: “Ahabu yakoreye Bayali mu ntege nke, jewe Yehu nzoyikorera n’inkomezi nyinshi.

Nimunzanire abavugishwa ba Bayali, abakozi bayo hamwe n’abaherezi bayo bose. Murabe neza ntihagire n’umwe musiga inyuma kuko ngira mpereze Bayali ikimazi gihambaye. Uwutazoba yaje wese azokwicwa.” Ariko Yehu yari afise umugambi wo kurandura abakorera Bayali bose.
Yehu avuga ati: “Nimutumeko ikoraniro mw’izina rya Bayali.” Nuko baritumako.
Arungika intumwa ku bakozi ba Bayali mu gihugu cose ca Isirayeli kugira ngo baze, ntihagira n’umwe asigara inyuma. Ingoro ya Bayali yuzura abantu, uhereye imbere ugashitsa inyuma.
Yehu abwira uwari ajejwe kubika amakanzu ati: “Zanira amakanzu abakozi ba Bayali bose bambare.” Nuko arayabazanira.
Yehu na Yehonadabu mwene Rekabu binjira mu ngoro ya Bayali, Yehu abarira abakozi ba Bayali ati: “Musuzume neza ntihagire umukozi w’ Uhoraho yoba ari muri mwebwe, hagume abakozi ba Bayali gusa.”

Nuko batangura gutanga ibimazi baturira n’ibimota neza. Ariko Yehu yari yasize hanze abasoda mirongo umunani abihanikirije ati: “Hakagira umuntu n’umwe abatoroka akagenda, ni mwebwe muca mwicwa mu gishingo ciwe.”

Yehu agiheza guturira ibimota neza, aca ategeka abasoda biwe ati: “Nimwinjire mubice bose, ntihagire n’umwe abacika.” Bahejeje kubicisha inkota, abakuru n’abasanzi b’iyo ngoro ya Bayali baca basohora ibiziga vyabo babita hanze, binjira mu vyumba vyo hagati rwose muri iyo ngoro.
Basohora inkingi yari muri iyo ngoro, iyo bashikanirako ibimazi, barayiturira.
Bamenagura inkingi z’amabuye za Bayali basambura n’ingoro, ihinduka inzu yo kwihagarikamwo y’abantu bose gushika n’ubu.
Uko ni kwo Yehu yakuyeho ugusenga Bayali muri Isirayeli.
Ariko ntiyavuye mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakwegeyemwo n’Abisirayeli mu gusenga ibigirwamana vy’impfizi z’inka bicuzwe mu nzahabu, icari i Beteli n’icari i Dani.

Uhoraho abarira Yehu ati: “Ko wagize neza mu gukora ibibereye mu nyonga zanje, ugashitsa ivyo nipfuza gukorera ab’inzu ya Ahabu hamwe n’ibindi vyose nipfuza gukora, uruvyaro rwawe ruzokwicara ku ntebe y’ubwami bwa Isirayeli gushika ku runganwe rugira kane.”
Ariko Yehu ntiyitaho gukurikiza Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli n’umutima wiwe wose. Ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu, ivyo yakwegeyemwo n’Abisirayeli bakabikora.
Kuva ico gihe, Uhoraho atangura kugabanya ubunini bwa Isirayeli. Hazayeli atangura kwigarurira ibice bimwebimwe vyo mu gihugu ca Isirayeli,
ubuseruko bwa Yorodani harimwo Gileyadi mu ntara ya Gadi, Reyubeni na Manase, kuva Aroweri hafi y’akagezi Arunoni ugashitsa i Gileyadi n’i Bashani.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehu, ivyo yakoze n’ivyo yashitseko, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Yehu ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa i Samariya, umuhungu wiwe Yehowahazi aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Imyaka Yehu yamaze atwarira i Samariya yabaye mirongo ibiri n’umunani.
Ataliya nyina wa Ahaziya abonye ko umuhungu wiwe apfuye, arahaguruka ngo atikize umuryango w’umwami wose.

Ariko Yehosheba umukobwa w’umwami Yoramu akaba na mushiki wa Ahaziya, aca afata Yowashi mwene Ahaziya aramunyuruza, amukuye mu bandi bana b’umwami bagira bicwe, amunyegeza mu cumba co kuryamamwo ari kumwe n’umurezi wiwe, kugira ngo amuhishe Ataliya, uko ni ko yarokotse.
Yowashi n’umurezi wiwe bamara imyaka itandatu banyegejwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho mu gihe Ataliya ari we yatwara ico gihugu.

Mu mwaka ugira indwi, Yehoyada umuherezi atumako intwazangabo zitwara abasoda ijanijana, abo mu Bakariti, n’abarinzi bo ku kirimba, abajana mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Agiriranira isezerano na bo, aranabarahiza bari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Hanyuma, aca abereka wa mwana w’umwami.
Yehoyada ababwira ati: “Ibi ni vyo mukwiye gukora: mwebwe abari mu migwi itatu izoba iramukiwe gukora kw’Isabato, umugwi wa mbere uzocungera ikirimba c’umwami,
umugwi wa kabiri ucungere Irembo rya Suri, uwa gatatu na wo uhagarare inyuma y’abacunze ikirimba. Iyo migwi yose uko ari itatu izoza irakuranwa mu gucungera ingoro.
Namwe abari mu yindi migwi ibiri itazoba ifise ibikorwa vyo kw’Isabato, muzocungera umwami mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Muzohagarare mukikuje umwami, mufise ibigwanisho mu maboko yanyu. Nihagira uwegera aho muri azokwicwe. Muzogume hafi y’umwami aho azoja hose.”

Izo ntwazangabo zirongoye ingabo ijanijana zibikora nk’uko Yehoyada umuherezi yabibabwiye. Umwe wese ahitana abantu biwe, baba abari baramukiwe kuja ku bikorwa vyo kw’Isabato, canke abari bagombowe, bose babazana imbere ya Yehoyada umuherezi.
Na we abaha amacumu n’inkinzo vyari ivy’umwami Dawidi, vyari vyabitswe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Za ngabo, umwe wese afise ikigwanisho mu minwe, zikikuza umwami; hafi y’igicaniro n’Ingoro, kuva mu bumanuko ukaja mu buraruko bw’Ingoro.

Yehoyada aca asohokana umwana w’umwami amwambika urugori, amushikiriza n’ikopi y’ivyagezwe vy’Uhoraho, maze amenyesha ko abaye umwami. Bamusukako amavuta mu kumwimika, abari ngaho bose bakomera amashi rimwe, bavuga bati: “Umwami nahangame!”
Maze Ataliya yumvise urwamo rw’ingabo n’abandi bantu, aca aja iyo bari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Aravye, abona umwami, ahagaze hafi y’inkingi nk’uko umugenzo wari uri. Intwazangabo n’abavuza inzamba bari i ruhande yiwe, abantu bose bo mu gihugu bariko baranezerwa bavuza inzamba. Maze Ataliya yitaburirako impuzu arasemerera ati: “Uwo ni umugararizo! Uwo ni umugararizo!”

Umuherezi Yehoyada aca abwira intwazangabo zitwara abasoda ijanijana ati: “Nimumusohore hanze mumucishe hagati y’imirongo y’ingabo kandi mwicishe inkota uwomukurikira wese,” kuko yari yavuze ati: “Ntiyicirwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .”
Nuko baramufata bamucisha mw’irembo ry’amafarasi rija ku mbuga y’ingoro y’umwami, bamwiciraho.
Yehoyada aca agiriranira isezerano n’ Uhoraho hamwe n’umwami n’abantu, ko bazoba abantu b’ Uhoraho . Yongera ashiraho isezerano hagati y’umwami n’abantu.

Abantu bose b’ico gihugu baca baja ku ngoro ya Bayali barayisenyagura. Basitagura ibicaniro n’ibigirwamana bicika ivu, bafata Matani umuherezi wa Bayali, bamwicira imbere y’ibicaniro. Maze umuherezi Yehoyada agena abantu bacungera Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .

Hanyuma ahitana za ntwazangabo z’abasoda ijanijana, ba bacangero b’Abakariti, abacungera ikirimba hamwe n’abantu bose bo muri ico gihugu, bakura umwami mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bamutwara ku kirimba, yinjirana irembo ryarimwo abasoda bamucungera. Umwami abona kwicara mu kibanza ciwe ku ntebe y’ubwami.
Abari aho bose bagira umunezero, n’igisagara kiba amahoro kuko Ataliya yari yamaze kwicishwa inkota muri ico kirimba.
Yehowashi yari afise imyaka indwi igihe yaba umwami.
Mu mwaka ugira indwi Yehu ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli ni ho Yowashi yaba umwami w’i Buyuda, aganza imyaka mirongo ine ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Zibiya, yava i Berisheba.
Yehowashi yakoze ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe mu myaka yose yamaze amenyerezwa n’umuherezi Yehoyada.
Ariko na we nyene ntiyashoboye gukuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi; abantu babandanije gushikanirayo ibimazi no gutuririraho ibimota neza.
Umusi umwe, Yowashi abarira abaherezi ati: “Nimwegeranye amahera yashikaniwe Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , yaba ayashikanwa n’abaharuwe bose, ayo abantu biyemeje nk’isezerano canke ayo bashikana bavyishakiye.
Hanyuma umuherezi wese yakire kuri ayo mahera, ayakoreshe ivyo abona ko bikwiye gusanurwa ku Ngoro.”
Ariko mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri na gatatu Yowashi ari ku ngoma, abo baherezi ntibari bwasanure Ingoro.

Nuko Yowashi atumako umuherezi mukuru ari we Yehoyada hamwe n’abandi baherezi ababaza ati: “Ni kubera iki mutarasanura Ingoro? Ntimuze mwongere gukoresha amahera mu vyo mukeneye. Kuva ubu amahera yose ategerezwa gukoreshwa ku vyo gusanura Ingoro gusa.”
Ba baherezi baca bemera ko batazosubira gutoza amahera mu bantu, kandi ko atari bo ubwabo bazokurikirana ibikorwa vyo gusanura Ingoro.

Yehoyada aca afata isandugu ayicako intoboro ku mupfundikizo, ayitereka i ruhande y’igicaniro, ku ruhande rw’i buryo iyo umuntu ariko arinjira mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Abaherezi barinda urwinjiriro rw’urusengro bakaja barayishiramwo amahera yose atanzwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Igihe cose babona ko amashikanwa yabaye menshi muri ya sandugu, umwanditsi w’umwami ari kumwe n’umuherezi mukuru baca baza, bagaharura amahera yaba yatanzwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bakayashira mu mifuko.
Amahera bategekanije akwiye baciye bayaha abashinzwe gukurikirana ibikorwa vy’ingoro. Ni yo bakoresheje mu guhemba abakoze ibikorwa vyo gusanura Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , abasakara, ababaji,
abubaka impome n’ababaza amabuye. Baragura imbaho, bakabazisha amabuye kugira ngo basanure Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , bagatanga n’amahera yose yari akenewe ku gikorwa cose kijanye no gusanura iyo Ngoro.
Amahera yatanzwe ntiyakoreshejwe mu gucurisha amabesani, ibikombe canke ibindi bikoresho vyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho bicuzwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza.
Yose yakoreshejwe mu guhemba abakoze ibikorwa vyo gusanura Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
Ntibigeze banasaba abo bahaye ayo mahera ngo babereke ingene yakoreshejwe kuko vyaragaragara ko bayakoresheje mu bwizigirwa bwose.
Amahera yatangwa n’abantu nk’impongano y’ivyaha ntiyajanwa muri ya sandugu yo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho . Yari yagenewe abaherezi.
Muri ico gihe ni ho Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya yaduga gutera i Gati, arahigarurira. Mu nyuma y’aho aca aja gutera i Yerusalemu.

Ariko Yowashi umwami w’i Buyuda aca afata ivy’agaciro vyose vyari vyareguriwe Uhoraho , vyatanzwe na Yehoshafati, Yehoramu na Ahaziya, ari bo bami batwaye imbere yiwe, afata n’ivyo we ubwiwe yari yareguriye Uhoraho , n’inzahabu zose zari mu bubiko bw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho no mu kirimba c’umwami, abirungikira Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya, na we abona gusubira inyuma, ntiyatera Yerusalemu.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yowashi, hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyose, vyaditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda.
Mu nyuma abatware biwe bamugira inama, bamwicira i Beti-Milo, kw’ibarabara rija i Sila.

Abatware bamwicishije bari Yozabadi mwene Shimeyati na Yehozabadi mwene Shomeri. Bompi bari abahanuzi biwe b’abizigirwa. Bamuhamba hamwe na ba sekuru mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Amaziya amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri na gatatu Yowashi mwene Ahaziya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, ni ho Yehowahazi mwene Yehu yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, amara imyaka cumi n’indwi atwarira i Samariya.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze yongera abikwegeramwo Abisirayeli, kandi ntiyigeze abivamwo.
Maze uburake bw’ Uhoraho buziriringira Isirayeli, bituma Uhoraho yemera ko bamara imyaka myinshi batwazwa igitugu na Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya, hamwe na Beni-Hadadi umuhugu wiwe.
Mu nyuma Yehowahazi arondera mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , na we aramwumvira, kuko yari yabonye ingene umwami w’i Siriya yashize Isirayeli mu gacinyizo gateye ubwoba.
Uhoraho arokora Abisirayeli, bava musi y’ubutegetsi bwa Siriya. Abisirayeli basubira kuba amahoro mu vyabo nk’uko vyahora.

Ariko na ho nyene ntibava mu vyaha vy’abo mu muryango wa Yerobowamu, ivyo yakoze akongera akabikwegeramwo Abisirayeli, na bo babandanya muri vyo, ntibakura n’inkingi ya Ashera yari ihagaze i Samariya.

Ico gihe, ingabo za Yehowahazi zari zisigaye ari ubusa, kuko yari asigaranye amafarasi mirongo itanu, imikogote cumi n’abasoda ibihumbi cumi gusa. Umwami w’i Siriya yari yaratikije ayandi mafarasi n’imikogote hamwe n’abandi basoda, abigira nk’umukungugu wo ku mbuga.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehowahazi, n’ibindi vyose yakoze hamwe n’ivyo yashitseko vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Mu nyuma Yehowahazi ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa i Samariya. Umuhungu wiwe Yehowasi aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’indwi Yowashi ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, ni ho Yehowashi mwene Yehowahazi yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, atwarira i Samariya imyaka cumi n’itandatu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze akongera akabikwegeramwo Abisirayeli, na bo bakabandanya babikora.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yowashi, ivyo yakoze vyose n’ivyo yashitseko, birimwo n’intambara yagwanye na Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Yowashi ahambije ba sekuruza, Yerobowamu aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma, na we ahambwa i Samariya hamwe n’abandi bami ba Isirayeli.

Igihe Elisa yari amaze kugwara cane, ingwara yahavuye imuviramwo urupfu, umwami Yowashi wa Isirayeli yagiye kumusuhuza, aramuririra ati: “Data, data! Wewe wabereye Abisirayeli imikogote n’abagendera ku mafarasi!”
Elisa amubwira ati: “Akira umuheto n’imyampi.” Na we aravyakira.
Yongera amubwira ati: “Fata umuheto mu maboko yawe.” Amaze kuwufata, Elisha na we aca afatisha amaboko yiwe ku maboko y’umwami.

Elisa amubwira ati: “Ugurura idirisha ritumbereye mu buseruko.” Umwami araryugurura. Amubwira ati: “Rasa!” Na we ararasa. Elisa aca avuga ati: “Uwo ni umwampi w’ Uhoraho urimwo intsinzi kuri Siriya. Abasiriya uzobatikiza ubamarire muri Efeki.”
Yongera kumubwira ati: “Fata imyampi.” Umwami arayifata. Elisa amubwira ati: “Yirase hasi.” Umwami arasa hasi incuro zitatu hanyuma ageza aho.
Wa muntu w’Imana aca araraka ati: “Wari kurasa nk’incuro zitanu canke zitandandu. Ni ho wonesheje Aramu ukahatikiza. Ariko noneho uzohanesha incuro zitatu gusa.”
Hanyuma y’ivyo, Elisa arapfa, arahambwa. Kandi igihe cose iyo umwaka ugeze aho imvura igomba gucika hama hariho imigwi y’abasuma bava i Mowabu bakinjira muri Isirayeli.

Umusi umwe hari Abisirayeli bariko barahamba umuntu, maze baja babona umugwi w’abasuma, baca baterera ikiziga ca wa muntu mu mva ya Elisa. Ca kiziga gikoze ku magufa ya Elisa, uwo muntu aca asubira kuba muzima, arahagarara.
Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya acinyiza Abisirayeli mu gihe cose Yehowahazi yamaze ari ku ngoma.
Ariko Uhoraho abagirira ubuntu n’imbabazi, arabitaho kubera isezerano yasezeraniye Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo. Gushika n’ubu Uhoraho ntiyigeze abatikiza ngo abamare, canke ngo abirukanire kure yiwe.
Hazayeli umwami w’i Siriya apfuye, umuhungu wiwe Beni-Hadadi aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.

Ni ho Yehowashi mwene Yehowahazi yaka Beni-Hadadi mwene Hazayeli ibisagara vyari vyarafashwe ku ngoma ya se Yehowahazi. Yehowasi anesha Beni-Hadadi incuro zitatu, abona kwigarurira ibisagara vyose vyari vyaranyazwe.
Mu mwaka ugira kabiri Yowahazi mwene Yehowahazi ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli, ni ho Amaziya mwene Yowashi yatangura kuganza i Buyuda.
Yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n’icenda ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yehoyadini, w’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, ariko ntiyashikira sekuruza Dawidi. Muri vyose yakurikiye ingeso za se Yowashi.
Amaziya ntiyashoboye gukuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi; abantu babandanije gushikanirayo ibimazi no gutuririraho ibimota neza.
Amaze gukomeza ubwami bwiwe, aca afata abatware bishe umwami ari we se arabica.

Ariko ntiyica abana b’abo bicanyi, kuko yubashe ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryanditswe mu Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe vya Mose rivuga riti: “Ntihaze hagire umuvyeyi yicwa azira abana biwe, canke abana ngo bicwe bazira abavyeyi babo, umwe wese azozire ivyaha vyiwe.”
Amaziya ni we yaneshereje abasoda ibihumbi cumi vy’Abanyedomu mu Kiyaya c’Umunyu. Ni na we yigaruriye Sela ayita Yokiteyeli, haracitwa gutyo gushika n’ubu.
Umusi umwe Amaziya arungikira intumwa Yehowashi mwene Yehowahazi, Yehowahazi mwene Yehu umwami wa Isirayeli, amubwira ati: “Ingo duhure, tugwane imbonankubone!”

Ariko Yehowashi umwami wa Isirayeli yishura Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda ati: “Muri Libani habaye igitovu, kibwira isederi ry’i Libani kiti: ‘Mpa umukobwa wawe abe umugore w’umuhungu wanje.’ Ariko haca haza igikoko kinini gihonyanga ca gitovu.
Ego data waranesheje Edomu none wuzuye ubwibone! Nezererwa intsinzi yawe hanyuma ugume iwawe. Ni kubera iki wikwegera amakuba, ukayakwegera n’Ubuyuda bwose?”
Ariko Amaziya ntiyamwumvira, maze Yehowashi umwami wa Isirayeli aratera. We na Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda bahanganira i Beti-Shemeshi mu Buyuda, bagwana imbonankubone.
Abayuda baneshwa n’Abisirayeli, umusoda wese ahunga ataha i muhira iwe.

Yehowashi umwami wa Isirayeli acakira Amaziya umwami w’i Buyuda mwene Yowashi, Yowashi mwene Ahaziya, amufatira ahitwa Beti-Shemeshi. Maze Yehowashi aca aja i Yerusalemu, asenyurira hasi uruzitiro rw’i Yerusalemu uhereye kw’Irembo rya Efurayimu ugashitsa kw’Irembo ryo mu Mfuruka, ahantu hangana n’ingero z’igice c’ukuboko amajana ane.
Asahura inzahabu n’ifeza n’ibindi bikoresho vyose vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho hamwe n’ubutunzi bwose bwari mu ngoro y’umwami. Afata n’abantu abagira inyagano, hanyuma asubira i Samariya.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehowashi, ivyo yakoze hamwe n’ivyo yashitseko, harimwo n’intambara yagwanye na Amaziya, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Yehowashi amaze gupfa, ahambwa hamwe na ba sekuruza i Samariya. Umuhungu wiwe Yerobowamu aca aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Amaziya mwene Yowashi umwami w’i Buyuda yamaze imyaka cumi n’itanu inyuma y’urupfu rwa Yehowashi mwene Yehowahazi umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Amaziya, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Maze ab’i Yerusalemu bagira inama yo kumwica, na we aca arahunga aja i Lakishi, ariko barungika abantu bamusanga i Lakishi bamutsindayo.
Bamugarukana i Yerusalemu kw’ifarasi, bamuhamba hamwe na ba sekuruza mu Gisagara ca Dawidi.
Maze abantu bose b’i Buyuda bahitamwo Uziya, yari afise imyaka cumi n’itandatu, aba ari we bagira umwami mu gishingo ca se Azariya.
Inyuma y’urupfu rwa se, Uziya ni we yasubiriye kwubaka igisagara ca Elati, agisubiza ku Buyuda.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi na gatanu Amaziya ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, Yerobowamu mwene Yowashi umwami wa Isirayeli ni ho yaza i Samariya atwarirayo imyaka mirongo ine n’umwe.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze yongera abikwegeramwo Abisirayeli.
Ni we yasubijeho imbibe za Isirayeli, kuva i Lebo-Hamati gushika ku kiyaga ca Araba, nk’uko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli yabivugishije umusavyi wiwe Yona mwene Amitayi, umuvugishwa yava i Gati-Heferi.
Uhoraho yari yabonye amakuba n’imibabaro Abisirayeli barimwo, baba abagurano canke abidegemvya, ata kibatabara.
Kuko Uhoraho atari yarigeze avuga ko azohanagura izina rya Isirayeli kw’isi, abakirisha ukuboko kwa Yerobowamu mwene Yowashi.

Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yerobowamu, ibijanye n’ukuntu yakomeje igisoda ciwe, intambara yagwanye, n’ingene yagarukanye ibisagara vya Damasiko na Hamati kuri Isirayeli, ibisagara vyari vyarigaruriwe na Yuda, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’Abisirayeli.
Yerobowamu arahava ahamvya ba sekuruza, ari bo bami ba Isirayeli. Umuhungu wiwe Zakariya aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.

headings.text: Ivya Yerobowamu wa Kabiri, umwami wa Isirayeli

verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri n’indwi Yerobowamu umwami wa Isirayeli ari ku ngoma, Azariya mwene Amaziya ni ho yaba umwami w’i Buyuda.
Ico gihe yari afise imyaka cumi n’itandatu, hanyuma aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n’ibiri ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yekoliya, w’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko se Amaziya yakora.
Ariko ntiyashoboye gukuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi; abantu babandanije gushikanirayo ibimazi no gutuririraho ibimota neza.
Uhoraho ateza imibembe umwami gushika ku musi yapfiriyeko, kandi yaba mu kazu ka wenyene. Yotamu umwana w’umwami aca aba ari we azezwa ikirimba, yongera atwara abantu bo muri ico gihugu.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Azariya hamwe n’ibindi vyose yakoze, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Azariya arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Yotamu aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’umunani Azariya ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, ni ho Zakariya mwene Yerobowamu yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, atwarira i Samariya amezi atandatu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko abatwaye imbere yiwe babikoze. Ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze akanabikwegeramwo Abisirayeli.
Hanyuma Shalumu mwene Yabeshi arondera ingene yokwica Zakariya. Amuterera imbere y’abantu, amwiciraho, aca aramusubirira nk’umwami.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Zakariya vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Uko ni ko ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryavugishijwe kuri Yehu ryashitse. Ryavuga riti: “Uruvyaro rwawe ruzokwicara ku ntebe y’ubwami bwa Isirayeli gushika ku runganwe rugira kane.”
Shalumu mwene Yabeshi yabaye umwami wa Isirayeli mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’umunani Uziya umwami w’i Buyuda ari ku ngoma, atwarira i Samariya ukwezi kumwe.
Maze Menahemu mwene Gadi ava i Tiriza aduga i Samariya, atera Shalumu mwene Yabeshi, aramwica, aca aramusubirira nk’umwami.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Shalumu n’ivy’abo yateguye kwica, vyanditse mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Ico gihe Menahemu atera Tifusa n’imihana ihegereye gushika i Tiriza, arahatikiza kuko abantu baho banse kwishikana kuri we. Yica abantu bose, afomoza n’abagore bafise inda.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’icenda Azariya ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, Menahemu mwene Gadi ni ho yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, atwarira i Samariya imyaka cumi.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze akanabikwegeramwo Abisirayeli.
Maze Puli umwami wa Ashuri atera igihugu ca Isirayeli, Menahemu amuha italanto igihumbi z’ifeza, kugira ngo amufashe gukomeza ubwami bwiwe, anamufashe no kuguma ku ngoma.

Menahemu akura ayo mahera mu butunzi bwa Isirayeli. Umutunzi wese yasabwa gutanga n’imiburiburi shekeli mirongo itanu z’ifeza zo guha umwami wa Ashuri. Maze umwami wa Ashuri ntiyaba agitera Isirayeli, ava no muri ico gihugu asubira inyuma.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Menahemu, n’ivyo yakoze vyose, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Menahemu arahava ahamvya ba sekuruza, umuhungu wiwe Pekahiya aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itanu Azariya ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, ni ho Pekahiya mwene Menahemu yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, atwarira i Samariya imyaka ibiri.
Pekahiya akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze akanabikwegeramwo Abisirayeli.

Umwe mu bakuru b’intwazangabo bakuru yitwa Peka, mwene Remaliya, arondera ingene amwica. Ahitana abasoda mirongo itanu i Gileyadi bajana na we, yica Pekahiya, amwicana na Arugobu na Ariyehi abicira mu nzu imwe yo ku kirimba i Samariya. Uko ni ko Peka yishe Pekahiya aca amusubirira ku ngoma nk’umwami w’Abisirayeli.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Pekahiya hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyose vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itanu na kabiri Azariya ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, ni ho Peka mwene Remaliya yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, atwara imyaka mirongo ibiri aba i Samariya.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ntiyava mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, ivyo yakoze akanabikwegeramwo Abisirayeli.

Ku ngoma ya Peka, umwami wa Isirayeli, Tigulati-Pileseri umwami wa Ashuri ni ho yigarurira Iyoni, Abeli-Beti-Mayaka, Yanowa, Kedeshi na Hazori. Yongera afata Gileyadi na Galilaya harimwo n’intara yose ya Nafutali, atwara n’abantu mu buja.
Maze Hoseya mwene Ela arondera ingene yica Peka mwene Remaliya. Aramutera aramwica, aca aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma. Aho hari mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri Yotamu mwene Uziya ari ku ngoma.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Peka hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyose, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami ba Isirayeli.
Mu mwaka ugira kabiri Peka mwene Remaliya ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli, Yotamu mwene Uziya ni ho yaba umwami w’i Buyuda.
Yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka icumi n’itandatu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yerusha, umukobwa wa Zadoki.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza, nk’uko se Uziya yakora.

Ariko ntiyashoboye gukuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi; abantu babandanije gushikanirayo ibimazi no gutuririraho ibimota neza. Yotamu ni we yasanuye Irembo ryo Haruguru y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho .
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yotamu hamwe n’ivyo yakoze, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Muri ico gihe ni ho Uhoraho yatangura kuja ararungika Rezini, umwami w’i Siriya, hamwe na Peka mwene Remaliya, gutera i Buyuda.
Yotamu arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca sekuruza Dawidi. Umuhungu wiwe Ahazi aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’indwi Peka mwene Remaliya ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli, Ahazi mwene Yotamu ni ho yaba umwami w’i Buyuda.

Ahazi yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’itandatu ari i Yerusalemu. Ariko ntiyakora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yakora.

Yagendeye mu ngeso z’abami ba Isirayeli, mbere agera n’aho atanga umuhungu wiwe ngo aturirwe nk’ikimazi. Uko ni ko yakoze ibizira vy’ubuyobe vyakorwa n’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye muri ico gihugu imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Atanga ibimazi yongera aturira n’ibimota neza, abikorera hejuru mu mataba y’imisozi miremire no musi y’igiti cose gitotahaye.
Rezini umwami w’i Siriya na Peka mwene Remaliya umwami wa Isirayeli baduga gutera Yerusalemu, bugariza Ahazi ariko ntibashobora kumufata.
Ico gihe, Rezini umwami w’i Siriya ni ho yasubira kwigarurira igisagara ca Elati kuri Siriya, mu kuhirukana Abayuda. Abanyedomu baciye bimukira muri ico gisagara ca Elati, ni ho bakiba gushika n’ubu.
Ahazi aca atuma kuri Tigulati-Pileseri, umwami w’i Ashuri, ati: “Ndi umusavyi wawe, kandi ndi musi y’ubutware bwawe. Ntabara uze unkize umwami w’i Siriya n’uwa Isirayeli, banteye.”
Ahazi afata inzahabu n’ifeza vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho no mu bubiko bw’ingoro y’i bwami, abirungikira umwami w’i Ashuri nk’ishikanwa.
Umwami w’i Ashuri atera umugwa mukuru w’i Siriya ari wo Damasiko, arahafata. Abantu baho abagira imbohe, abimurira i Kiru, yongera yica umwami Rezini.

Hanyuma Ahazi aca aja i Damasiko kubonana na Tigulati-Pileseri umwami wa Ashuri. Ari ngaho abona igicaniro kidasanzwe i Damasiko, aca arungikira Uriya umuherezi w’i Yerusalemu igicapo caco n’ibikigize vyose, kugira ngo yubake ikindi nk’ico nyene.
Nuko Uriya yubaka ico gicaniro akurikije uko umwami yamubwiye, umwami agarutse avuye i Damasiko asanga yarahejeje kucubaka.
Umwami ashitse avuye i Damasiko, aracegera arakiraba, agishikanirako amashikanwa.
Ashikana amashikanwa yo guturira hamwe n’ay’ifu, agisukako n’ibinyobwa, akimijagirako n’amaraso y’ibimazi vy’amashimwe.
Umwami Ahazi aca yimura ca gicaniro ca mbere c’umwakaka, agikura imbere y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , agishira ku ruhande ahahera mu buraruko bw’ico gishasha.

Umwami Ahazi aca aha amategeko umuherezi Uriya ati: “Iki gicaniro kinini gishasha, uzohore ugitangirako ibimazi biturirwa vyo mu gatondo hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu yo ku mugoroba, ibimazi biturirwa vy’umwami hamwe n’amashikanwa y’ifu yiwe, hamwe n’ibimazi biturirwa vy’abantu bose, n’amashikanwa y’ifu yabo, hamwe n’amashikanwa yabo y’ibinyobwa. Uzomijagire amaraso y’ibimazi biturirwa vyose kuri iki gicaniro gishasha. Nayo igicaniro c’umwakaka nzomenya ico ndagikoresha.”
Umuherezi Uriya abikora nk’uko umwami Ahazi yabimutegetse.

Umwami Ahazi akuraho ibikoresho vyo ku ruhande bijana n’igicaniro harimwo n’ibesani nini y’umwakaka yo gukarabiramwo, akuraho n’ibishushanyo vy’impfizi vyari bikozwe mu mwakaka iyo besani yari ihagazeko, ayitereka hasi ku mabuye.
Akuraho n’ibaraza ryari ryubatse mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho ryakoreshwa kw’Isabato, akuraho n’ubwinjiriro bw’umwami bwo hanze. Ivyo vyose yabikoze kugira ngo anezereze umwami wa Ashuri.
Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Ahazi hamwe n’ibindi vyose yakoze, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Ahazi arapfa ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa hamwe na bo mu Gisagara ca Dawidi. Maze umuhungu wiwe Hezekiya amusubirira ku ngoma.
Mu mwaka ugira mirongo ibiri Ahazi ari ku ngoma i Buyuda, Hoseya mwene Ela ni ho yaba umwami wa Isirayeli, atwara imyaka umunani aba i Samariya.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, ariko ntiyanganya n’abami baganje imbere yiwe.
Shalumaneseri umwami wa Ashuri aduga gutera Hoseya, aramunesha, maze Abisirayeli bategekwa kwama batanga amashikanwa yo kwisaba menshi ku mwaka ku mwaka, bayaha Ashuri.

Mu nyuma umwami wa Ashuri amenya ko Hoseya ariko ararondera kumugarariza mu kurungika intumwa ku mwami So wa Egiputa, kugira ngo amufashe kwikura musi y’agacinyizo ka Ashuri. Ivyo vyatumye Shalumaneseri aca amufata amushira mw’ibohero.
Umwami w’i Ashuri araza atera igihugu cose ashika i Samariya, arahugariza kumara imyaka itatu.
Mu mwaka ugira icenda Hoseya ari ku ngoma, umwami wa Ashuri afata Samariya, atwara Abisirayeli bose mu buja, abimurira ahitwa Halahi mu ntara ya Gozani hafi y’uruzi Habori mu bisagara vy’Abamedi.
Ivyo vyose vyabaye kw’ihanga ry’Abisirayeli kuko bacumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana yabo, yabakuye muri Egiputa, musi y’ububasha bwa Farawo umwami wa Egiputa, hanyuma bagasenga izindi mana.
Bagendeye mu ngeso z’abanyamahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye imbere yabo, no mu bikorwa bibi abami ba Isirayeli bigeneye gukora.
Abisirayeli bakoreye mw’ibanga n’ibindi bidahimbara Uhoraho Imana yabo. Biyubakiye ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi mu bisagara vyose kuva ku minara y’abarinzi gushika mu bisagara vyubatswe neza.
Biyubakira ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vy’amabuye n’inkingi za Ashera ku misozi miremire no musi y’ibiti bininibinini.
Baturirira ibimota neza ku misozi nk’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye imbere yabo. Bakoze ibibi vyinshi vyatumye Uhoraho abarakira.
Basenze ibigirwamana, kandi Uhoraho yari yarabihanikirije ngo ntibaze bakore ikintu nk’ico.

Uhoraho yaburiye Isirayeli n’Ubuyuda aciye ku bavugishwa n’abateramyi biwe, avuga ati: “Nimuve mu nzira zanyu mbi. Mukurikize amategeko n’amabwirizwa yanje yose ari mu Vyagezwe, ivyo nahaye ba sogokuruza banyu nkongera nkabibaha nciye ku basavyi n’abavugishwa banje.”
Ariko ntibamwumviye, bakomantaza imitima nka ba sekuruza, batigeze bemera kwizera Uhoraho Imana yabo.

Bataye amategeko yiwe hamwe n’isezerano yagiranye na ba sekuruza, hamwe n’imburi yagiye arabarungikira. Bakurikiye ibigirwamana ata co bimaze, amaherezo na bo bacika imburakimazi nka vyo. Bagendeye mu ngeso z’amahanga abakikuje, kandi Uhoraho yari yarabihanikirije ati: “Ntimuzokwigenze nk’uko bigenza,” ariko bakora ivyo Uhoraho yari yarababujije.
Bashiburiye kure amategeko y’ Uhoraho Imana yabo, bicurira ibigirwamana bibiri mw’ishusho y’impfizi, bishingira n’inkingi ya Ashera. Bunamira inyenyeri zo kw’ijuru, bongera basenga Bayali.
Bagera n’aho batanga abana babo nk’ibimazi ku bicaniro, bagendera mu bupfumu no kuraguza, biyegurira gukora ibibi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , bituma uburake bw’ Uhoraho bubaziriringira.
Uburake bw’ Uhoraho ni bwo bwatumye abirukana mu nyonga ziwe, hasigara umuryango wa Yuda wonyene.
Ariko Abayuda na bo nyene ntibagendeye mu mabwirizwa y’ Uhoraho Imana yabo. Bagendeye mu nzira z’ivyaha nk’ivy’Abisirayeli.
Ni ho Uhoraho yaheba Abisirayeli, akabateza ivyago, akabarekurira mu maboko y’ababanyaga utwabo gushika n’aho abomora akabakura mu nyonga ziwe.
Uhoraho amaze gukura Abisirayeli ku bwami bwa Dawidi, bimitse Yerobowamu mwene Nebati nk’umwami wabo. Yerobowamu akwegera Abisirayeli kure y’ Uhoraho , atuma bakora ivyaha vyinshi.
Abisirayeli bagendera mu vyaha vya Yerobowamu, ntibigera babivamwo,

gushika aho Uhoraho abirukana imbere yiwe, nk’uko yari yarabivugishije abasavyi biwe bose ari bo bavugishwa. Ni co catumye Abisirayeli batwarwa nk’inyagano muri Ashuri, ari na yo bakiri gushika n’ubu.

Maze umwami wa Ashuri azana abantu abakuye i Babiloni, i Kuta, muri Ava, muri Hamati n’i Sefaruvayimu, abashira mu bisagara vya Samariya, basubirira Abisirayeli. Nuko bigarurira Samariya n’ibisagara vyaho, babibamwo.
Bakihashika ntibasenga Uhoraho , bituma arungika intare zica abatari bake muri bo.

Maze haza intumwa ku mwami wa Ashuri imubwira iti: “Abantu watwaye ukabakwiragiza mu bisagara vy’i Samariya ntibazi ingene basenga imana yaho. Ni co gituma yarungitse intare muri bo, ubu zikaba ziri mu kubamara.”
Maze umwami wa Ashuri aca atanga itegeko ati: “Nimufate umuherezi umwe mu bo mwazanye mu buja, mumurungike asubire i Samariya, yigishe abimukiyeyo ivyagezwe vy’imana y’ico gihugu.”
Nuko umuherezi umwe mu bari batwawe bava i Samariya asubirayo, aba i Beteli, yigisha ababayo gusenga Uhoraho .
Ariko na ho nyene, imigwi itandukanye y’abanyamahanga yikorera imana zayo, mu bisagara babamwo, bashira ibigirwamana mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo Abisirayeli bari barubatse.
Abari bavuye i Babiloni basenga Sukoti-Benoti, abavuye i Kuta bagasenga Nerugali, abavuye i Hamati na bo bagasenga Ashima.
Abari bavuye muri Awa basenga imana zabo Nibati na Tarutaki. Abari bavuye i Sefaruvayimu baturira abana babo bwite nk’ibimazi vyo gushikanira Adurameleki na Anameleki.
Barasenga Uhoraho ariko bashiraho n’abantu batandukanye babagira abaherezi bo gushikana ibimazi mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi.
Kandi naho basenga Uhoraho babandanije kumubangikanya no gukorera imana zabo bamwebamwe bose ukurikije ukuntu bari basanzwe babikora mu mahanga baje bavamwo.
Kugeza n’ubu baracashishikara iyo migenzo yabo. Ntibasenga Uhoraho canke ngo bakurikize amabwirizwa, amategeko n’Ivyagezwe Uhoraho yahaye uruvyaro rwa Yakobo, uwo yahavuye yita Isirayeli.
Igihe Uhoraho yagirana isezerano n’Abisirayeli, yari yababwiye ati: “Ntimuzosenge izindi mana, ngo muzipfukamire, canke ngo muzikorere, muzishikanire n’ibimazi.
Muzosenge Uhoraho wenyene, uwabakuje muri Egiputa ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi, azobe ari we wenyene musenga.
Muzokwame mukurikiza Ivyagezwe, amabwirizwa n’amategeko, ntihaze hagire izindi mana musenga.
Ntimuzokwigere mwibagira isezerano nabagiriye, ngo musenge izindi mana.
