Uhoraho Imana yanyu, azobe ari we musenga wenyene, kuko ari we azobakiza abansi banyu.”
Ariko ntibamwumviye, bigumiye mu ngeso zabo za kera.
N’abo bantu bashasha iyo basenga Uhoraho , bamubangikanya n’ibigirwamana. Kandi gushika n’ubu, abuzukuru n’abuzukuruza babo baracakora ibikorwa nk’ivya ba sekuruza.

headings.text: Hoseya umwami wa nyuma wa Isirayeli

verses.text: Mu mwaka ugira gatatu Hoseya mwene Ela umwami wa Isirayeli ari ku ngoma, ni ho Hezekiya mwene Ahazi yaba umwami w’i Buyuda.
Yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aganza imyaka mirongo ibiri n’icenda ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina yitwa Abiya, umukobwa wa Zakariya.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko sekuruza Dawidi yakora.

Akuraho ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku mataba y’imisozi, amenagura inkingi z’amabuye, atemagura n’inkingi za Ashera. Amenagura na ya nzoka y’umwakaka Mose yamanika ku giti, ayigira ifu, kuko bari basigaye bayisenga, bakayituririra n’ibimota neza. Iyo nzoka y’umwakaka bayita Nehushitani.
Hezekiya yizeye Uhoraho , Imana ya Isirayeli. Nta mwami yogereranywa na we, haba mu batwaye i Buyuda imbere yiwe canke abatwaye inyuma yiwe.
Yifatanije n’ Uhoraho , ntiyigera amuvako, yitondera ivyagezwe Uhoraho yahaye Mose.
Uhoraho yabanye na we, amuha kugira umugisha mu vyo yakora vyose, yiganzura umwami wa Ashuri, ntiyaba akimuha amashikanwa y’agacinyizo.
Yanesheje Ubufilisitiya gushika i Gaza n’ibisagara vyaho vyose.
Mu mwaka ugira kane umwami Hezekiya ari ku ngoma, hari mu mwaka ugira indwi Hoseya mwene Ela ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli, ni ho Shalumaneseri umwami w’i Ashuri yatera i Samariya akahugariza.
Inyuma y’imyaka itatu ni ho Ashuri yafata Samariya. Hari mu mwaka ugira gatandatu Hezekiya ari ku ngoma, hakaba mu mwaka ugira icenda Hoseya ari ku ngoma muri Isirayeli.
Umwami wa Ashuri atwara Abisirayeli nk’abaja, abimurira i Halahi, mu ntara ya Gozani ku nkengera y’uruzi Habori no mu bisagara vy’Abamedi.
Ivyo vyabaye kuko batumviye Uhoraho Imana yabo, bagata isezerano; ntibumvire ivyo Mose umusavyi w’Uhoraho yabategetse. Ntibumviye ivyagezwe ngo babigenderemwo.
Mu mwaka ugira icumi na kane umwami Hezekiya ari ku ngoma, Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri atera ibisagara bizitijwe inzitiro z’amabuye vyose vy’i Buyuda, arabifata.

Hezekiya Umwami w’i Buyuda araheza arungikira ubutumwa umwami wa Ashuri aho yari i Lakishi amubwira ati: “Naragucumuyeko. Ndagusavye usubire inyuma, nanje nzoheza ntange amashikanwa y’agacinyizo yose uzontegeka gutanga.” Umwami wa Ashuri aca ategeka Hezekiya gutanga italanto amajana atatu z’ifeza hamwe n’iz’inzahabu mirongo itatu.
Nuko Hezekiya amuha ifeza zose zari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho hamwe no mu bubiko bw’ikirimba.
Hezekiya yongera yomorora inzahabu zari ku miryango no ku bishimaryango vy’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , aziha umwami wa Ashuri.

Naho vyabaye gutyo, umwami w’i Ashuri aca arungika kizigenza mu ntwaramiheto, umukuru w’ingabo, n’umukuru w’ikambi, bava i Lakishi bajana n’ingabo nyinshi cane, bagiye gusugereza umwami Hezekiya i Yerusalemu. Bashitseyo, bahagarara ku mugende utwara amazi ku rugomero rwo haruguru, kw’ibarabara rija kw’Itongo ry’Umumesuzi.
Baca batumako umwami, ariko umwami arungika Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya umukuru w’ikirimba, na Shebuna umunyamabanga w’umwami, na Yowa mwene Asafu umwanditsi, baba ari bo baja guhura na bo.
Maze Umukuru w’ingabo za Ashuri ababwira ati: “Mubwire Hezekiya muti: ‘Umwami ahambaye, ari we mwami w’i Ashuri avuze ngo: Mbega wishimirije iki?
Uvuga ngo ufise ubuhinga bwo kugwana ukagira n’ingabo nyinshi. Ariko ivyo ni amajambo gusa ata co amaze. Mbe wishimirije nde yotuma ungarariza?
Mbega wishimiye Egiputa? Rirya renga rivunitse ricumita mu kiganza uwo wese aryishimikije! Uko ni ko Farawo umwami wa Egiputa ameze ku bamwizigira bose.

Niwaba na ho ugira uti: “Twishimikije Uhoraho Imana yacu,” mbega si wewe nyene Hezekiya wayisamburiye ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi hamwe n’ibicaniro, ukabwira Ubuyuda na Yerusalemu uti: “Muzohora musengera imbere y’igicaniro c’i Yerusalemu honyene”?
None rero, ingo muhige na databuja, umwami w’i Ashuri. Nanje ndaguha amafarasi ibihumbi bibiri, nimba unafise abashobora kuyagenderako!
Mbega none wewe, woshobora gute kwirukana intwazangabo naho yoba ari imwe yo mu ngabo za databuja zo hanyuma y’izindi, naho wozanana n’imikogote n’abagwanira ku mafarasi b’Abanyegiputa?
Turetse n’ivyo, mbe wibaza ko twaje gutera no gusambura aha hantu ata co Uhoraho yatubwiye? Uhoraho ubwiwe ni we yambwiye kuza gutera iki gihugu no kugisangangura.’ ”

Maze Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya na Shebuna na Yowa babwira uwo mukuru bati: “Turakwinginze twebwe abasavyi bawe utubwire mu Carameya, kuko tucumva. Ntubandanye uvuga mu Giheburayo abantu bose bari ku ruzitiro bavyumva.”

Ariko uwo mukuru w’ingabo abishura ati: “Mbega mwibaza ko databuja yarungikiye ubutumwa shobuja wenyene? N’abo bari ku ruzitiro nibavyumve kuko nimutishikana, tuzobugariza mwicwe n’inzara n’inyota gushika aho murya umwanda mukuru wanyu, munywe n’umwanda mutoya wanyu.”
Maze uwo mukuru w’ingabo arahaguruka avuga n’ijwi rirenga mu Giheburayo ati: “Nimwumve ijambo ry’umwami ahambaye, ari we mwami w’i Ashuri!
Avuze ngo: Ntimwemere ko Hezekiya abahenda. Ntashobora kubakiza ngo abakure mu kuboko kwanje.
Ntahave abahenda ngo mwizere Uhoraho ababwira ngo: ‘ Uhoraho azodukiza, ntazokwemera ko iki gisagara kigwa mu maboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri.’

Ntimwumvirize Hezekiya. Ibi ni vyo umwami w’i Ashuri abamenyesheje: Nimurondere amahoro mu kwishikana iwanje. Ni ho umwe wese muri mwebwe azorya ku nzabibu no ku nsukoni ziwe, akanywa no ku mazi y’iriba ryiwe,

gushika aho nzobatwarira mu gihugu kimeze nk’iki c’iwanyu, igihugu kirimwo ingano n’umuvinyu mushasha, igihugu cuzuye indya n’imizabibu, igihugu c’imyelayo n’ubuki; maze muzobaho, ntimuzopfa. Ariko ntimwumvire Hezekiya kuko azoba ariko arabahenda niyababwira ati: ‘ Uhoraho azoturokora.’
Mbega hari imana z’ihanga na rimwe zigeze zirokora igihugu cazo mu kuboko kw’umwami w’i Ashuri?
Mbega imana z’i Hamati n’i Arupadi ziri hehe? Imana z’i Sefaruvayimu, iz’i Hena no muri Iwa ziri hehe? Mbega zarakijije Samariya mu maboko yanje?
Mbega mu mana zose z’ivyo bihugu, ni izihe zashoboye kubikiza ukuboko kwanje? None Uhoraho ni we yokiza Yerusalemu mu maboko yanje?”
Ariko abantu bari ngaho baguma banumye, ntihagira ico bishura, kuko umwami yari yabihanikirije ati: “Ntihagire na kimwe mumwishura.”

Maze Eliyakimu mwene Hilukiya uwari ajejwe ikirimba, na Shebuna umunyamabanga, hamwe na Yowa mwene Asafu umwanditsi, basubira kwa Hezekiya, bitaburiyeko impuzu, bamubwira ivyo wa mukuru w’ingabo yavuze vyose.
Umwami Hezekiya avyumvise yitaburirako impuzu, yambara amagunira, aja mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Aca arungika Eliyakimu umukuru w’ikirimba, Shebuna umunyamabanga hamwe n’abaherezi bakurira abandi, baja kuraba umuvugishwa Yesaya mwene Amozi, kandi bose bagenda bambaye amagunira.
Baramubwira bati: “Umwami Hezekiya avuze ati: Uwu ni umusi w’amagorwa, ibihano n’ibiteterwe, tumeze nka kurya umwana ageze kuvuka ariko nyina akabura inkomezi zo kumuvyara.

Kumbure Uhoraho Imana yawe yokwumva amajambo yose y’uwo mukuru w’ingabo, ayo yarungikanywe na shebuja umwami w’i Ashuri, yo gucokora Imana nzima; maze Uhoraho Imana yawe akabimuhanira. None rero udusengere twebwe abagisigaye.”
Abatware b’umwami Hezekiya baja kwa Yesaya,
na we aca ababwira ati: “Gende mubwire shobuja muti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ntimugire ubwoba kubera ivyo mwumvise, ari yo majambo yo kuntuka y’umwami w’i Ashuri.
Umviriza! Ngiye kumushiramwo impwemu izotuma yumva inkuru z’ibihuha, azoca afata ingingo yo gusubira mu gihugu ciwe, aho nzotuma yicwa n’inkota.’ ”
Wa mukuru w’ingabo yumvise ko umwami w’i Ashuri yavuye i Lakishi, aca ahamagara ingabo ziwe baja kuraba umwami, basanga ariko agwanira i Libuna.
Ico gihe nyene Senakeribu aca aronka inkuru zimubwira ko Tiruhaka umwami wa Etiyopiya, azananye n’ingabo ziwe baje kumutera. Imbere yo gusubira inyuma, asigira ubutumwa Hezekiya, avuga ati:
“Mubwire Hezekiya umwami w’i Buyuda muti: ‘Iyo mana wishimiye ntiguhende ngo izobuza ko Yerusalemu hafatwa n’umwami w’i Ashuri.
Ndazi ko wumvise ivyo abami b’i Ashuri bakoreye ayandi mahanga, ingene babaranduye bakabamara. None wibaza ko wewe uzorokoka?
Mbega imana z’ayo mahanga yatikijwe na ba sogokuruza zarayakingiye? Za mana za Gozani, Harani, Rezefu n’abantu bo muri Edeni baba i Teli Asari, zarashoboye kubakiza?
Mbega umwami w’i Hamati ari hehe canke umwami w’i Arupadi? Abami b’ibisagara vya Sefaruvayimu, Hena na Iwa bari hehe?’ ”
Maze Hezekiya yakira ikete ahawe n’intumwa ararisoma, aca aduga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , arizingururira imbere y’ Uhoraho .
Asenga Uhoraho avuga ati: “ Uhoraho Mana ya Isirayeli, wewe wicaye ku ntebe y’inganji hagati y’abakerubi, ni wewe Mana wenyene mu bwami bwose bwo kw’isi. Ni wewe waremye ijuru n’isi.
Tega ugutwi Mana yanje, wumve. Utereze inyonga zawe urabe, ewe Uhoraho ; wumve amajambo Senakeribu yarungitse yo gucokora Imana nzima.
Uhoraho we, ni ivy’ukuri ko abami b’i Ashuri batikije ayo mahanga yose n’ibihugu vyayo.
Bataye imana zabo mu muriro barazitikiza, kuko zitari Imana, vyari ibiti n’amabuye, vyakozwe n’amaboko y’abana b’abantu.
None rero Uhoraho Mana yacu, dukize udukure mu maboko yiwe, kugira ngo ubwami bwose bwo kw’isi buzomenye ko wewe wenyene, Uhoraho , ari wewe Mana.”
Yesaya mwene Amozi arungikira ubutumwa Hezekiya avuga ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: Numvise ugusenga kwawe ku vyerekeye Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri.
Aya ni yo majambo Uhoraho amurungikiye: Umukobwa w’i Siyoni aragukengereye kandi aragutwenze. Umukobwa w’i Yerusalemu akuzungurije umutwe akuraba ingene uhunga.
Mbega wibaza ko uwo watutse ukongera ukamucokora ari nde? Ni nde warengeje urwamo, ukamurabisha amaso yawe y’agakengerwe? Ni Uwera wa Isirayeli.

Watumye intumwa zawe ziza kuntuka jewe Imana. Uravuga uti: ‘Naduganye imikogote yanje myinshi nshika hejuru ku misozi, ndetse nshika no kw’isonga rya Libani. Niciye amasederi asumvya ayandi uburebure, n’ubujwari busumvya ubundi ubwiza. Narahagendagenze nshika no mu bibanza vyaho vya kure, ngenzura n’amashamba yaho atotahaye cane.
Nimvye amariba mu yandi mahanga, nywa n’amazi yaho. Mponyangisha ibirenge vyanje inzuzi za Egiputa, gushika aho zikama.’
Mbega ntiwari bwavyumve? Ivyo vyose ni jewe nagenye ko bizoba kuva kera. Nabiteguye kera cane, none ubu ndabishikije, ntuma ufata ibisagara bifise inzitiro zikomeye ubihindura ibirundo vy’amabuye.
Abantu bo muri vyo wabamaze amanyama, bacika ivutu, baramaramara. Bameze nk’ivyatsi vyo mu gahinga, nk’ubwatsi bukimera. Bameze nk’utwatsi twimeza ku nzu hejuru, dukabirana tutarakura.
Ariko ndakuzi neza, ndazi aho uri, ndazi amaja n’amaza yawe; ndazi n’ingene wandakiye.
None rero ko wandakiye, amajambo yawe atagira indero agashika mu matwi yanje, nzogutungira igera mu zuru, ndagushire umunyororo mu kanwa, ndagusubize inyuma, uciye mu nzira wazananye.

Yewe Hezekiya, iki ni co kimenyetso uhawe: Uwu mwaka uzorya ivyimejeje, umwaka ukurikira uzorya ibizonaga kuri vyo. Ariko ku mwaka ugira gatatu, uzobiba wimbure, utere imizabibu, urye ku vyamwa vyayo.
Nayo amasigarira y’abacitse kw’icumu yo mu muryango wa Yuda azokwongera amere nk’igiti gishora imizi mu kuzimu, maze hejuru amashami na yo akama ivyamwa.
Kuko i Yerusalemu hazokwamuka amasigarira, no ku musozi Siyoni have abacitse kw’icumu. Ishaka ry’ Uhoraho Mushoboravyose ni ryo rizoshitsa ivyo.

Ku bw’ivyo, uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze ku mwami w’i Ashuri: ‘Ntazokwinjira mu gisagara c’i Yerusalemu canke ngo araseyo umwampi. Ntazokwegera inzitiro yitwaje inkinzo yiwe, canke ngo azubakeko ivyo kwuririrako ngo ahatere.
Inzira yazananye ni yo izomusubiza inyuma; ntazokwinjira iki gisagara,’ ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
‘Nzogwanira iki gisagara ndakirokore, ku bwanje no ku bw’umusavyi wanje Dawidi.’ ”
Iryo joro nyene umumarayika w’ Uhoraho araza, atera insago z’Abashuri, yica ingabo ibihumbi ijana na mirongo umunani na bitanu. Abantu bavyutse mu gitondo basanga imivyimba irambaraye ahantu hose.
Maze Senakeribu umwami w’i Ashuri aca asubira inyuma, aja kuba i Ninewe agumayo.

Umusi umwe, Senakeribu ari mu ngoro ya Nisuroki imana yiwe ariko arasenga, abahungu biwe Adurameleki na Sharezeri baraza bamwicisha inkota, bahungira mu gihugu c’i Ararati. Umuhungu wiwe Esaruhadoni aca amusubirira ku ngoma.
Muri iyo misi, Hezekiya aragwara, ashika ku mpfiro. Umuvugishwa Yesaya mwene Amozi aja kumuraba, amubwira ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ngo: ‘Tunganya ivyo mu rugo rwawe, kuko ugiye gupfa, ntuzokira.’ ”
Maze aca ahindukiriza amaso ku ruhome, asenga Uhoraho ,
avuga ati: “ Uhoraho we, ibuka ingene nagendeye imbere yawe mu bwizigirwa nkagukorera nguhaye umutima wanje wose, ngakora ivyo ubona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga zawe.” Hezekiya ararira cane.
Ariko imbere y’uko Yesaya arengana mu rugo ataha, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rimuzako,

riti: “Subira inyuma ubwire Hezekiya, umutware w’ubwoko bwanje uti, uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana ya sogokuruza Dawidi avuze: ‘Numvise ugusenga kwawe, kandi nabonye amarira yawe, none ngiye kugukiza. Inyuma y’imisi itatu uzoduga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Nzokwongera iyindi myaka cumi n’itanu yo kubaho. Kandi wewe n’iki gisagara nzobakiza amaboko y’umwami w’i Ashuri. Nzogwanira iki gisagara ku bw’izina ryanje no ku bw’umusavyi wanje Dawidi.’ ”
Maze Yesaya avuga ati: “Nimutegure akarobe kabumvye mu nsukoni.” Barakazana, bagashira ku kivyimba, Hezekiya aca arakira.
Hezekiya abaza Yesaya ati: “Ikimenyetso kizonyereka ko Uhoraho yankijije, ngashobora gusubira kuduga mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho inyuma y’imisi itatu ni ikihe?”
Yesaya aramwishura ati: “Iki ni co kimenyetso ko Uhoraho azokora ivyo yasezeranye: Ushaka ko igitutu kija imbere yawe amatambwe cumi canke inyuma yawe amatambwe cumi?”
Hezekiya yishura ati: “Ni ibisanzwe ko igitutu kija imbere amatambwe cumi, ahubwo nikije inyuma amatambwe cumi.”
Maze Yesaya yambaza izina ry’ Uhoraho , na we ahindukiza igitutu gisubira inyuma ya Ahazi amatambwe cumi.
Muri ico gihe nyene, Merodaki-Baladani mwene Baladani, umwami w’i Babiloni, arungikira Hezekiya amakete yo kumusuhuza hamwe n’utuganuke, kuko yari yumvise ko yagwaye.

Hezekiya yakira neza abazanye ubwo butumwa, abereka mu nzu hose n’ivyari mu bubiko vyose: ifeza, inzahabu, ibimota neza, amavuta, abereka n’imyambaro y’intambara, hamwe n’ibindi vyose vyari mu bubiko bwiwe. Nta na kimwe cari ku kirimba canke mu bwami bwose ataberetse.
Umuvugishwa Yesaya aragenda abaza umwami Hezekiya ati: “Abo bantu bakubwiye iki, kandi baje bava he?” Hezekiya amwishura ati: “Baje bava mu gihugu ca kure; bavuye i Babiloni.”
Yesaya aramubaza ati: “Babonye iki ku kirimba iwawe?” Hezekiya amwishura ati: “Babonye ibintu vyose biri mu ngoro yanje. Nta na kimwe c’ubutunzi bwanje ntaberetse.”
Yesaya abwira Hezekiya ati: “Niwumve ijambo ry’ Uhoraho :
Hazogera igihe aho ibiri muri iyi ngoro vyose, ivyo ba sogokuruza bawe begeranije gushika uwu musi, bizotwarwa i Babiloni. Nta na kimwe kizosigara, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
Kandi bamwe bo mu ruvyaro rwawe, abana bawe bwite, bazogukomokako, uwundi azoza abatware, bagirwe inkone ku kirimba c’umwami w’i Babiloni.”
Hezekiya amwishura ati: “Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho uvuze ni ryiza.” Aho rero ni kubera yibwira mu mutima ati: “Kazima mu gihe nzoba nkiriho hazoba hari amahoro.”

Ibindi vyose vyabaye ku ngoma ya Hezekiya, ivyo yashitseko, ingene yubatse ikidengeri, n’ingene yubatse umugende uca mu kuzimu uzana amazi mu gisagara, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Maze Hezekiya ahamvya ba sekuruza, umuhungu wiwe Manase amusubirira ku ngoma.
Manase yabaye umwami afise imyaka cumi n’ibiri, aganza imyaka mirongo itanu n’itanu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Hefiziba.
Manase akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu bizira vy’ubuyobe vyakorwa n’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarirukanye imbere y’Abisirayeli.

Asubira kwubaka ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi, ivyo se Hezekiya yari yarasanganguye; yongera kwubaka ibicaniro vya Bayali n’inkingi ya Ashera, nk’uko Ahabu umwami wa Isirayeli yari yarakoze. Yunamira ibinyenyeri vyose vyo kw’ijuru, arabisenga.
Yubaka ibicaniro mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho, iyo Uhoraho yari yaravuzeko ati: “I Yerusalemu nzohashira izina ryanje.”
Mu rugo rwose rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ahubaka ibicaniro vy’ibinyenyeri vyose vyo kw’ijuru.
Agera n’aho atanga umuhungu wiwe kw’ikimazi co guturirwa, agendera mu bupfumu n’amareba, ahanuza abahamagara imizimu hamwe na ba kamenyi. Akora ibibi vyinshi mu nyonga z’ Uhoraho , bituma amuratsa.

Afata inkingi ya Ashera yabazishije, ayishira mu Ngoro, imwe Uhoraho yari yabwiye Dawidi n’umuhungu wiwe Salomo ati: “Muri iyi Ngoro, n’i Yerusalemu, ni ho natoranije mu yindi miryango yose ya Isirayeli, ngo hitirirwe izina ryanje ibihe vyose.
Sinzosubira gutuma Abisirayeli bayerera ngo bave mu gihugu nahaye ba sekuruza babo nibagendera mu vyo nabategetse vyose, bagakurikiza Ivyagezwe vyose umusavyi wanje Mose yabahaye.”
Ariko abantu ntibayumviye. Manase yarabazimije, atuma bava mu nzira z’Uhoraho, bakora ibibi birengeye ivy’amahanga Uhoraho yari yarahonereje imbere y’Abisirayeli.
Maze Uhoraho avugisha abasavyi biwe b’abavugishwa,
ati: “Manase, umwami w’i Buyuda, yakoze ivyaha birenze urugero. Yakoze ibibi bisumba ivy’Abamori baba mu gihugu imbere y’Abisirayeli, akwegera Abayuda mu vyaha vyo gusenga ibigirwamana.
None rero Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli, avuze ati: Nzotera amakuba Yerusalemu n’i Buyuda hose, gushika aho abazovyumva bose bazojorerwa.
I Yerusalemu nzohacira urubanza nk’urwo naciriye Samariya, ndahagerere no ku ngero nagereyeko umuryango wa Ahabu. Nzohanagura ababa i Yerusalemu nk’uwuhanagura isahani hanyuma akayubika.
Nzokwanka amasigarira y’ubwoko bwanje, ndabarekurire mu maboko y’abansi babo. Bazotwarwa ari inyagano ku bansi babo,
kuko bakoze ibizira mu nyonga zanje, bantera kubarakarira uhereye igihe nabakura muri Egiputa gushika n’uwu musi.”

Ikigeretseko, Manase yasheshe amaraso y’abantu benshi ata co bazira, yuzura igisagara ca Yerusalemu uhereye iyo kiva kikagera. Ivyo vyiyongera ku vyaha yakwegeyemwo Abayuda, bakora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Manase n’ivyo yakoze vyose, harimwo n’ivyaha vyiwe, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda?
Haheze igihe, Manase ahamvya ba sekuruza, ahambwa mw’itongo ryo ku kirimba iwe, mw’itongo ryitwa irya Uza. Umuhungu wiwe yitwa Amoni aca aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Amoni yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’ibiri igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza imyaka ibiri ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Meshulemeti umukobwa wa Haruzi w’i Yotiba.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko se Manase yakoze.
Yagendeye mu ngeso zose za se; yasenze ibigirwamana se yasenga, akama yikubita imbere yavyo.
Ava k’ Uhoraho Imana ya ba sekuruza, ntiyigera agendera mu nzira z’ Uhoraho na gatoya.
Maze abaganwa ba Amoni baja inama yo kumwica, bamutsinda mu ngoro iwe.
Ariko abantu bo muri ico gihugu baca bafata abishe umwami Amoni barabica, bimika Yosiya umuhungu wiwe, aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Amoni hamwe n’ivyo yakoze, vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda.
Yahambwe mw’itongo ryitwa irya Uza, umuhungu wiwe Yosiya aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Yosiya yari afise imyaka umunani igihe yaba umwami, aca aganza imyaka mirongo itatu n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Yedida, umukobwa wa Adaya, w’i Bozikati.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari vyiza mu nyonga ziwe, agendera mu nzira zose za sekuruza Dawidi, ntiyahengamira i buryo canke i bubamfu.
Mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani ari ku ngoma, umwami Yosiya ahamagara umunyamabanga wiwe yitwa Shafani mwene Azaliya, Azaliya mwene Meshulamu, amutuma mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .
Amubwira ati: “Genda ubwire Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru, yegeranye amahera yatanzwe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , ayo abakozi bo ku miryango y’ingoro bari begeranije ava mu bantu.
Maze ayahe abantu b’abizigirwa, bagenewe gukurikirana neza ibikorwa vyo mu Ngoro. Abo bantu na bo bazohembe abazokora ibikorwa vyo gusanura Ingoro y’ Uhoraho ;
ababaji n’abubatsi, maze bongere bagure imbaho, babazishe n’amabuye yo gusanura Ingoro.
Ariko ntibazokwirirwa barabazwa uko bazoba bakoresheje amahera bahawe, kuko ari abizigirwa.”
Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru abwira Shafani umwanditsi ati: “Ndatoye Igitabu c’Ivyagezwe mu Ngoro y’Uhoraho.” Aca agiha Shafani, na we aragisoma.
Maze Shafani asubira inyuma abarira umwami ati: “Abatware bawe batanze amahera yari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , bayahaye abo bizeye ko bokurikirana ibikorwa vyo mu Ngoro.”
Yongera abwira umwami ati: “Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru yampaye iki gitabu.” Hanyuma Shafani agisomera imbere y’umwami.
Maze umwami yumvise amajambo yo muri ico Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe, aca yitaburirako impuzu.
Aca ategeka Hilukiya umuherezi, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, Akibori mwene Mikaya, Shafani umunyamabanga w’umwami na Asaya umukozi w’umwami ati:

“Nimugende munsigurize Uhoraho jewe n’abantu n’ab’i Buyuda bose ku vyerekeye ivyanditswe muri iki gitabu catowe. Uburake bw’Uhoraho bwasutswe kuri twebwe burateye ubwoba kuko ba sogokuruza batumviye amajambo ari muri iki gitabu, ngo bakore ibihwanye n’ivyanditswemwo.”

Umuherezi Hilukiya hamwe na Ahikamu, Akibori, Shafani na Asaya baca baja kuvugana na Hulida umuvugishwa, yari umugore wa Shalumu mwene Tikiva, Tikiva mwene Haruhasi uwari ajejwe imyambaro yo mu Ngoro. Uwo Hulida yaba i Yerusalemu mu gice gishasha c’igisagara.
Na we ababwira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze: ‘Nimugende mubwire uwabantumyeko muti
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Ngiye guteza icago aha hantu n’abantu baho, nk’uko vyanditswe mu gitabu umwami w’i Buyuda yasomye.
Kuko bantaye, bagaturirira ibimota neza izindi mana, bakandakisha ibigirwamana amaboko yabo yakoze, uburake bwanje buzoziriringira aha hantu, kandi nta kizobuhwamika.
Nimugende mubwire umwami w’i Buyuda yabatumye kumusiguriza Uhoraho , muti: Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana ya Isirayeli avuze ku vyerekeye amajambo wumvise:

Ko umutima wawe wakozweko, ukicisha bugufi imbere y’ Uhoraho ucumva amajambo navuze kuri aha hantu no ku bantu baho ko bagiye guherengetera no gucika umuvumo, kandi ko witaburiyeko impuzu ukaririra imbere yanje; nanje nakwumvise, ni ko Uhoraho avuze.
None rero nzoguha kwitahira amahoro uhamvye ba sogokuruza bawe. Amaso yawe ntazobona ivyago vyose ngiye guteza aha hantu.’ ” Nuko bashira umwami iyo nyishu abahaye.
Umwami akoranya abakuru bose b’i Buyuda n’i Yerusalemu.

Adugana ku Ngoro y’ Uhoraho n’abantu bose b’i Buyuda, ababa i Yerusalemu, abaherezi hamwe n’abavugishwa, n’abantu bose uhereye ku muto ugashitsa ku mukuru. Abasomera amajambo yo muri ca Gitabu c’Isezerano cari catowe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho .

Ahejeje ahagarara i ruhande y’inkingi, asubizaho isezerano imbere y’ Uhoraho ko agiye kwubaha Uhoraho , no gukurikiza amabwirizwa, amategeko hamwe n’ivyagezwe vyiwe, akabikora n’umutima wiwe wose n’umushaha wiwe wose, mu gushitsa ivyanditswe muri ico gitabu. Maze abantu bose bemera gusubira muri iryo sezerano.

Umwami aca ategeka umuherezi mukuru n’abakorana na we bose, n’abarinzi b’urwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho bose gukura ikintu cose cari cakorewe Bayali na Ashera hamwe n’ivy’ibinyenyeri vyo kw’ijuru. Babituririra inyuma y’igisagara ca Yerusalemu mu mwonga wa Kidironi, iminyota yavyo bayitwara i Beteli.

Yirukana abaherezi b’abanyamahanga bari bashizweho n’abami b’i Buyuda kugira ngo baze baraturirira ibimota neza ku misozi miremire yo mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda no mu yikikuje Yerusalemu. Bashikanira ibimota neza Bayali, izuba, ukwezi, inyenyeri hamwe n’ibindi vyose vyo kw’ijuru.
Asohora mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho inkingi ya Ashera bayitwara mu mwonga wa Kidironi inyuma y’igisagara ca Yerusalemu, bayituririrayo. Baca bafata umunyota wayo, baja kuwuta mw’itongo ry’abapfuye.
Yosiya yongera asambura inzu z’abamaraya b’abagabo n’abagore zari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , ari na ho abagore bajishira ibitambara bapfukisha inkingi ya Ashera.

Yongera ahamagaza abaherezi bose, kuva i Geba gushika i Berisheba, bakora igikorwa c’ubuherezi mu Buyuda bwose, ahumanya ibibanza vyose vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi batangiramwo ibimazi. I Yerusalemu, amenagura ibicaniro vyose vyari hafi y’Irembo rya Yosuwa umukuru w’igisagara, vyari i bubamfu bw’urwinjiriro.

Naho abaherezi bo mu bibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi batari bemerewe kugira ico bokora ku gicaniro c’ Uhoraho i Yerusalemu, barasangira n’abandi baherezi bagenzi babo imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Umwami yongera akuraho igicaniro ca Tofeti mu kiyaya ca Beni-Hinomu, ntihagira abasubira kuhashikanira abana babo nk’ibimazi vyo guturira babishikanira Moleki.

Akuraho amafarasi yari ku rwinjiriro rw’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho abami b’Abayuda bari barashikanye mu gusenga izuba. Ayo mafarasi yari mu kigo imbere, hafi y’inzu ya Natani-Meleki inkone, akaba n’umutware. Yosiya aca aturira imikogote yayo yari yarashikaniwe izuba.

Amenagura ibicaniro vyose abami b’i Buyuda bari bubatse hejuru ku bisenge vy’inzu ya Ahazi, asenyura n’ibicaniro vyose Manase yari yarubakishije mu mabaraza y’Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , arabimenagura bicika ubunywenywe, hanyuma baravyegeranya baja kubita mu mwonga wa Kidironi.

Umwami akuraho n’ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi vyari mu buseruko bwa Yerusalemu hepfo y’ivyo umwami Salomo yari yarubakiye ikigirwamanakazi Ashitaroti y’Abanyesidoni, Kemoshi imana y’Abanyamowabu, na Moleki imana y’Abamoni
Yowashi amenagura amabuye y’ibiterekerwa, atemagura inkingi za Ashera, aho vyari aharenzako amagufa y’abantu.

N’ibicaniro vy’i Beteli hamwe n’ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo ku misozi vyubatswe na Yerobowamu mwene Nebati, yari yakwegeye Abisirayeli mu vyaha, vyose arabimenagura. Aturira ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi, bicika iminyota, aturira n’inkingi ya Ashera.

Yosiya aravye hirya no hino abona imva nyinshi ku musozi. Aca ategeka ko bazikuramwo amagufa yose, hanyuma ayaturirira kuri ico gicaniro c’i Beteli kugira ngo agihumanye. Ivyo vyabaye nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabivugishije umuntu wayo igihe Yerobowamu yari ahagaze i ruhande y’igicaniro mu misi mikuru. Maze Yosiya ahindukiye akaraba ku ruhande, ni ho yabona imva y’umuntu w’Imana yabivugishijwe.

Aca arabaza ati: “Kiriya cibutso mbona hariya ni ic’iki?” Abantu bo muri ico gisagara baramwishura bati: “Ni imva y’umuntu w’Imana w’i Buyuda yavugishijwe ibi vyose uhejeje gukorera iki gicaniro c’i Beteli.”
Na we arababwira ati: “Nimuyireke, ntihagire uwukomakoma amagufa yiwe.” Nuko amagufa yiwe barayarengana, co kimwe n’ay’abandi bavugishwa bari bavuye i Samariya.

Yosiya asambura n’ibibanza vyo gusengeramwo vyo ku misozi mu bisagara vya Samariya vyari vyubatswe n’abami ba Isirayeli bigatera Uhoraho gushangashirwa, yongera arabihumanya nk’uko yabigenjeje i Beteli.
Yosiya yongera yica abaherezi bose bo ku bicaniro vyo muri ivyo bibanza vyo gusengeramwo yongera ahumanya ivyo bicaniro mu kubituririrako amagufa y’abantu, maze asubira i Yerusalemu.
Umwami aca atanga itegeko ku bantu bose ati: “Muzokwame muhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho nk’uko vyanditswe muri iki gitabu c’Isezerano.”
Ntihari bwigere hahimbazwa umusi mukuru wa Pasika nk’uwo, uhereye mu gihe abacamanza batwara igihugu ca Isirayeli ugashitsa ku bami b’Abisirayeli n’Abayuda.
Iyo Pasika y’ Uhoraho yahimbajwe mu mwaka ugira cumi n’umunani Yosiya ari ku ngoma i Yerusalemu.

Mu gukurikiza ivyo muri ico Gitabu c’Ivyagezwe cari catowe mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho na Hilukiya umuherezi mukuru, Yosiya yirukana abavugana n’imizimu, imana z’imiryango, hamwe n’ibindi bigirwamana vyose vyasengwa, haba i Yerusalemu canke i Buyuda hose.

Nta mwami yigeze abaho ameze nka Yosiya, haba mu batwaye imbere yiwe canke abatwaye inyuma yiwe; yagarutse k’ Uhoraho n’umutima wiwe wose n’umushaha wiwe wose, n’inkomezi ziwe zose, nk’uko Ivyagezwe vya Mose vyabivuga.
Ariko ubushangashirwe Uhoraho yari yaratewe n’Ubuyuda ntibwigeze buhwama kubera ivyo Manase yari yarakoze vyose vyatumye Uhoraho aterwa n’ishavu ryinshi.

Maze Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Nzirukana Abayuda mu maso yanje nk’uko nirukanye Abisirayeli, kandi nzokwihakana Yerusalemu, igisagara natoranije, hamwe n’Ingoro navugiyeko nti: ‘Izina ryanje rizoba muri yo.’ ”
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yosiya hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’i Buyuda.
Yosiya akiri ku ngoma, umwami wa Egiputa yitwa Farawo Neko aduga ku ruzi Efurate gufasha umwami w’i Ashuri. Umwami Yosiya aja kumutegera ngo amugwanye, ariko Neko amwicira i Megido aho bagwaniye.

Abantu biwe bashira ikiziga ciwe mu mukogote, bagikura i Megido, bagitwara i Yerusalemu, bamuhamba mu mva yiwe ubwiwe. Abantu bo muri ico gihugu bafata Yehowahazi mwene Yosiya bamurobanuza amavuta, ngo abe umwami mu gishingo ca se.
Yehowahazi yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itatu igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aca aganza amezi atatu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Hamutali, umukobwa wa Yeremiya w’i Libuna.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko ba sekuruza bakoze.

Farawo Neko amushira mw’ibohero i Ribula mu ntara y’i Hamati kugira ngo ntabandanye aganza i Yerusalemu; aca ategeka Abayuda gutanga amashikanwa yo kwisaba angana n’italanto ijana z’ifeza n’imwe y’inzahabu.
Farawo Neko aca yimika Eliyakimu uwundi muhungu wa Yosiya mu kibanza ca se, amuhindura izina, amwita Yehoyakimu. Nuko Yehowahazi ajanwa muri Egiputa, apfirayo.
Yehoyakimu aha Farawo Neko ayo mashikanwa y’ifeza n’inzahabu yaciriye Ubuyuda. Kugira ngo ayegeranye, yatangishije amakori abanyagihugu bose b’i Buyuda, akurikije uko batunze.
Yehoyakimu yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’itanu igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Zebidahi, umukobwa wa Pedaya w’i Ruma.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho Imana yiwe abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko ba sekuruza bakoze.
Ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu, umwami Nebukadineza w’i Babiloni atera igihugu c’i Buyuda, Yehoyakimu amubera umusavyi kumara imyaka itatu. Ariko inyuma yaho agarariza Nebukadineza.
Uhoraho aca arungika Abanyababiloni, Abaramu, Abanyamowabu, Abamoni n’Abasiriya, batera Ubuyuda. Barabusambura nk’uko Ijambo ry’ Uhoraho ryari ryabivuze riciye ku basavyi biwe ari bo bavugishwa.
Koko ivyo vyashikiye Ubuyuda nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabitegetse, kugira ngo abirukane mu maso hiwe, ku bw’ivyaha vyose Manase yakoze,
harimwo gusesa amaraso y’abantu ata co bazira, ayo yatembesheje nk’inzuzi i Yerusalemu, bituma Uhoraho yanka kuvyihanganira.
Ibindi vyabaye ku ngoma ya Yehoyakimu hamwe n’ivyo yakoze vyose, mbega ntivyanditswe mu gitabu c’ivyabaye ku ngoma z’abami b’Abayuda?
Nuko Yehoyakimu ahamvya ba sekuruza, maze Yehoyakini umuhungu wiwe aba ari we amusubirira ku ngoma.
Umwami wa Egiputa ntiyabaye agisubira kuva mu gihugu ciwe, kuko umwami wa Babiloni yari yafashe igihugu cose ahereye ku kagezi ka Egiputa ugashisa ku ruzi Efurate.
Yehoyakini yari afise imyaka cumi n’umunani igihe yimikwa ngo abe umwami, aganza amezi atatu ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Nehushita mwene Elunatani w’i Yerusalemu.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko se yakoze.
Ku ngoma ya Yehoyakini, abakuru n’ingabo za Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni baraza bugariza igisagara ca Yerusalemu,
na Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni ubwiwe arishikira mu gisagara mu gihe bari bacugarije.

Yehoyakini umwami w’i Buyuda, nyina wiwe, abasavyi biwe, abatware hamwe n’abubahwa biwe bose barishikana kuri Nebukadineza. Mu mwaka ugira umunani umwami w’i Babiloni ari ku ngoma, atwara Yehoyakini nk’imbohe.

Nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabivuze, Nebukadineza atwara ubutunzi bwose bwari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho no mu kirimba c’umwami, atwara ibikoresho vyari bicuzwe mu nzahabu Salomo umwami wa Isirayeli yari yarakoresheje akabishira mu Ngoro.
Atwara mu buja ababa i Yerusalemu bose: abatware, abasoda, abacuzi, abanyamyuga, bose hamwe bari ibihumbi cumi. Abakene bo muri ico gihugu ni bo bonyene basigaye.
Nebukadineza afata Yehoyakini, amutwara nk’imbohe i Babiloni, atwara na nyina w’umwami, abagore b’umwami, abatware biwe hamwe n’abakuru bo muri ico gihugu bose, abakuye i Yerusalemu.
Umwami wa Babiloni yongera atwara abasoda ibihumbi indwi, bakomeye cane, bamenyereye intambara, hamwe n’abacuzi n’abanyamyuga igihumbi b’abahinga.
Yimika Mataniya sewabo wa Yehoyakini nk’umwami, ahindura izina ryiwe amwita Zedekiya.
Zedekiya yari afise imyaka mirongo ibiri n’umwe igihe yaba umwami, aganza imyaka cumi n’umwe ari i Yerusalemu. Nyina wiwe yitwa Hamutali mwene Yeremiya w’i Libuna.
Akora ivyo Uhoraho abona ko ari bibi mu nyonga ziwe, nk’uko Yehoyakimu yakoze.
Ivyo vyose vyashikiye Yerusalemu n’Ubuyuda kubera uburake bw’ Uhoraho bwari bwaziririnze, akirukana abantu biwe mu maso hiwe.

Nuko, mu mwaka ugira icenda Zedekiya ari ku ngoma, ku musi ugira cumi w’ukwezi kw’icumi, Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aja gutera Yerusalemu ajanye n’ingabo ziwe zose. Bacumbika inyuma y’igisagara, bacubakira ivyo kwuririrako ku mpande zose.
Igisagara kiguma cugarijwe gushika mu mwaka ugira cumi na rimwe Zedekiya ari ku ngoma.
Ku musi ugira icenda w’ukwezi kwa kane, inzara iba nyinshi mu gisagara gushika aho abantu babura ico batamira.

Nuko, uruzitiro rw’igisagara bararusatura, maze mw’ijoro ingabo zose zirahunga ziciye mw’irembo riri hagati y’ibihome bibiri, hafi y’umurima w’umwami, naho Abanyababiloni bari bakikuje igisagara. Bahunga berekeye ikiyaya ca Yorodani citwa Araba.
Ariko ingabo z’Abanyababiloni zikurikira umwami bamufatira mu kiyaya c’i Yeriko. Abasoda biwe bose barasanzara, baramuta;
na we aca arafatwa, bamujana ku mwami w’i Babiloni yari i Ribula, aca amucira urubanza aho nyene.
Bicira abahungu ba Zedekiya imbere yiwe, na we bamunogora amaso, bamubohesha iminyororo, bamutwara i Babiloni.

Ku musi ugira indwi w’ukwezi kwa gatanu mu mwaka ugira cumi n’icenda Nebukadineza ari umwami w’i Babiloni, ni ho Nebuzaradani umukuru w’ingabo zo ku kirimba, akaba n’umwishikira w’umwami w’i Babiloni, yashika i Yerusalemu.
Aturira Ingoro y’ Uhoraho , ikirimba c’umwami, hamwe n’ayandi mazu yose yari i Yerusalemu. Inyubakwa zose zihambaye zo mu gisagara araziturira.
Abasoda bose b’i Babiloni bari barongowe n’uwo mukuru w’ingabo zo ku kirimba, baraza basenyura inzitiro zose z’i Yerusalemu.
Nebuzaradani umukuru w’abasoda bo ku kirimba, aca atwara mu kinyago abantu bose bari basigaye mu gisagara hamwe n’abasoda bari barishikanye ku mwami w’i Babiloni.
Ariko uwo mukuru w’ingabo zo ku kirimba, asiga bamwe mu bakene bo mu gihugu ngo bakorere imizabibu n’imirima.
Abanyababiloni basenyura za nkingi z’umwakaka hamwe na ca gikarabiro c’umwakaka n’ivyo cari giteretseko vyari mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , batwara n’umwakaka wabo i Babiloni.
Batwara n’udukono two kuyoreramwo umunyota, ivyo kuyoza umunyota, ibikombe, amapanu, hamwe n’ibindi bikoresho vyose vy’umwakaka vyakoreshwa mu Ngoro.
Wa mukuru w’abasoda bo ku kirimba atwara ibikoresho vyose vyari bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza, harimwo amabesani n’ivyo guturirirako ibimota neza.

Umwakaka wavuye muri za nkingi zibiri, ca gikarabiro bita ikiyaga na vya bitereko biterurwa, ivyo umwami Salomo yari yarakoze ngo bibe ivyo mu Ngoro y’ Uhoraho , vyari bifise uburemere butashobora gupimwa ku munzane.

Inkingi imwe yose yapima ingero z’igice c’ukuboko cumi n’umunani z’igihagararo. Umwashi w’umwakaka wari hejuru y’inkingi imwe wari ufise ingero z’igice c’ukuboko zitatu z’uburebure ukaba usharijweko amakomamanga y’umwakaka awukikuje. Ku yindi nkingi, hari uwundi mwashi ufise amakomamanga yawo nk’uko nyene.
Uwo mukuru w’abasoda bo ku kirimba agira imbohe Seraya umuherezi mukuru, Zefaniya umuherezi wa kabiri hamwe n’abarinzi b’irembo batatu.

Mu bari basigaye mu gisagara, atwara intwazangabo yatwara abasoda baja ku rugamba hamwe n’abahanuzi batanu b’umwami. Atwara n’umunyamabanga yari ajejwe kwinjiza abantu mu gisoda, hamwe n’abandi banyagihugu mirongo itandatu yasanze mu gisagara.
Iyo ntwazangabo Nebuzaradani ica ifata ba bantu bose ibashira umwami w’i Babiloni i Ribula.
Aca abicira aho nyene i Ribula mu ntara y’i Hamati. Uko ni ko Abayuda batwawe mu kinyago, bakurwa mu gihugu cabo.
Nebukadineza umwami w’i Babiloni aca agena Gedaliya mwene Ahikamu, Ahikamu mwene Shafani, ngo abe umutware w’abantu bari basigaye i Buyuda.

Maze intwazangabo zose n’abantu babo bumvise ko umwami w’i Babiloni yagenye Gedaliya ngo abe umukuru w’iyo ntara, baca baja kubonana na Gedaliya i Misipa. Abo na bo ni Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, Yohanani na Yonatani bene Kareya, Seraya mwene Tanihumeti, bene Efayi Umunetofati, na Yazaniya umuhungu w’Umumayaka, n’abantu babo.

Gedaliya aca arabarahira, arabahumuriza hamwe n’abantu babo ababwira ati: “Ntimutinye abatware b’Abanyababiloni. Nimugende mube amahoro mu gihugu, muyoboke umwami w’i Babiloni, ibindi vyose bizogenda neza.”
Ariko mu kwezi kugira indwi, Ishimayeli mwene Netaniya, Netaniya mwene Elishama, wo mu muryango w’abami, azanana n’abasoda cumi, bica Gedaliya ari kumwe n’Abayuda, n’Abanyababiloni i Misipa.
Maze abantu bose b’i Buyuda, uhereye kuri muto ugashika kuri mukuru, bari kumwe n’abakuru mu ngabo, baterwa n’ubwoba bw’Abanyababiloni, bahungira muri Egiputa.

Mu mwaka ugira mirongo itatu n’indwi Yehoyakini umwami w’i Buyuda ari mu kinyago, umwaka Evili-Merodaki yimikiwemwo ngo abe umwami w’i Babiloni, ni wo yarekuriyemwo Yehoyakini ava mw’ibohero. Hari ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri n’indwi w’ukwezi kwa cumi na kabiri.
Amufata neza, amuha n’ikibanza c’icubahiro gisumba ivy’abandi bami bari kumwe na we i Babiloni.
Nuko Yehoyakini ntiyasubira kwambara impuzu z’imbohe, kandi yama asangira n’umwami ku meza yiwe imisi yose yari asigaje y’ukubaho kwiwe.
Umwami yama aha Yehoyakini ku musi ku musi ivyo kumutunga imisi yose yari akiriho.
